title.zh: 卷三十五 本紀第三十五 孝宗三
title.raw: 卷三十五 本紀第三十五 孝宗三 Volume 35 Annals 35: Xiaozong 3

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛丑，侍御史謝廓然乞戒有司毋以程頤、王安石之說取士。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year, on the xinchou day of the first month, Remonstrating Censor Xie Kuoran petitioned that the authorities be cautioned not to select scholars on the basis of the teachings of Cheng Yi or Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on the first month's xinchou day, Remonstrating Censor Xie Kuoran asked that officials be warned not to recruit examination candidates according to the doctrines of Cheng Yi or Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷特旨免臣僚及寺觀科徭。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, special edicts exempting court officials and temples and monasteries from corvée levies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, special exemptions for court officials and for temples and monasteries from corvée levies were revoked.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔侍從、台諫、兩省官集議考課法。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, an edict ordered attendant officials, censors and remonstrators, and officials of the Two Departments to assemble and deliberate on the performance evaluation law.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict directed attendant officials, the censorate and remonstrance bureau, and Two Department officials to meet and discuss the official performance evaluation law.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，置州縣丁稅司。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jisi day, prefectural and county poll-tax offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jisi day, poll-tax offices were set up in prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 辛未，申嚴武臣呈試法。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the military officials' presentation examination regulations were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the regulations governing military officials' presentation examinations were strictly reinforced.

sentences.zh: 詔二廣毋以攝官人治獄。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the Two Guang circuits must not employ acting officials to try cases.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade the Two Guang circuits from using acting officials to hear legal cases.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禁解鹽入京西界。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Jie salt was forbidden to enter the Jingxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the entry of Jie salt into the Jingxi circuit was banned.

sentences.zh: 甲申。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day.

sentences.zh: 雨土。

translations.literal: Soil rained.
translations.idiomatic: Dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，威州蠻寇邊，討降之。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, the barbarians of Weizhou raided the border; they were attacked and made to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the tribal peoples of Weizhou raided the frontier; government forces attacked them until they surrendered.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，李彥穎罷。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the dingwei day, Li Yanying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingwei day, Li Yanying was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 給辰、沅、澧、靖四州刀弩手田。

translations.literal: Farmland was granted to the blade-and-crossbow militia of the four prefectures Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Land was allotted to the blade-and-crossbow militia of Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以史浩爲右丞相。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Shi Hao was appointed Right Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Shi Hao was made Right Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 己未，以王淮知樞密院事，趙雄參知政事。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Wang Huai was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Zhao Xiong Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Wang Huai was appointed to manage the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Zhao Xiong was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是春，黎州蠻出降。

translations.literal: That spring, the barbarians of Lizhou came out and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, the tribal peoples of Lizhou came forward and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑朔，詔葉衡任便居住。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the new moon day yichou, Ye Heng was ordered to reside wherever he chose.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month's new moon day yichou, Ye Heng was permitted to live wherever he wished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以禮部尚書范成大參知政事。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Minister of Rites Fan Chengda was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Minister of Rites Fan Chengda was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，知紹興府張津進羨余四十萬緡，詔以代民輸和買、身丁之半。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Zhang Jin, prefect of Shaoxing, presented surplus tribute of four hundred thousand strings of cash; an edict ordered it used in place of half the people's state-purchase and poll-tax payments.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Zhang Jin, prefect of Shaoxing, forwarded four hundred thousand strings of surplus revenue; an edict applied it toward half the people's state-purchase and poll-tax obligations.

sentences.zh: 賜禮部進士姚穎以下四百十有七人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Ministry of Rites metropolitan graduates, Yao Ying and four hundred seventeen others, were granted pass grades and formal status.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred seventeen Ministry of Rites metropolitan graduates, beginning with Yao Ying, were granted pass grades and formal status.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨土。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, soil rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以趙思奉使不如禮，罷起居舍人，仍降二官。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, because Zhao Si had performed his mission in a manner not conforming to protocol, he was removed as Attendant Archivist and demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, because Zhao Si had conducted his embassy in a manner unbecoming protocol, he was dismissed as Attendant Archivist and demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命後省擇中外所言利病不戾成法者以聞。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the Rear Secretariat was ordered to select from domestic and foreign memorials proposals on benefits and harms that did not contravene established law and report them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Rear Secretariat was ordered to choose from domestic and foreign memorials proposals on public benefit and harm that did not violate established law and report them upward.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，置武學國子員。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the gengzi day, Military Academy imperial-student quotas were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengzi day, imperial-student places at the Military Academy were established.

sentences.zh: 丁未，修臨安府城。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the walls of Lin'an Prefecture were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the walls of Lin'an Prefecture were repaired.

sentences.zh: 禁諸路州軍責屬縣進羨餘。

translations.literal: The practice was forbidden whereby circuit prefectures and garrisons compelled subordinate counties to forward surplus tribute.
translations.idiomatic: It was forbidden for circuit prefectures and garrisons to compel subordinate counties to forward surplus tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，飭百官及諸監司毋得請托。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, all officials and supervisory commissioners were admonished not to solicit favors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, all officials and circuit supervisory commissioners were warned not to solicit favors.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，范成大罷。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Fan Chengda was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Fan Chengda was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔京西、湖北商人以牛馬負茶出境者罪死。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, an edict made death the penalty for merchants of Jingxi and Hubei who transported tea beyond the border using oxen and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, an edict imposed the death penalty on Jingxi and Hubei merchants who used oxen and horses to carry tea out of the country.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔翰林學士、諫議大夫、給事中、中書舍人、侍御史各舉堪御史者二人。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, an edict required each Hanlin academician, Remonstrance Bureau grand master, Investigating Censor, Secretariat Drafter, and Attending Censor to recommend two men fit to serve as investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict required each Hanlin academician, Remonstrance Bureau grand master, Investigating Censor, Secretariat Drafter, and Attending Censor to nominate two men qualified to serve as investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 以給事中錢良臣簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Qian Liangchen was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Qian Liangchen was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，罷諸州私置稅場。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, privately established tax stations in the various prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, privately established tax stations in the prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 減四川茶課十五萬餘緡。

translations.literal: Sichuan's tea levy was reduced by more than one hundred fifty thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's tea levy was cut by more than one hundred fifty thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，蠲大理寺贓錢三萬九千餘緡。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, thirty-nine thousand-plus strings of fines owed to the Court of Judicial Review were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, more than thirty-nine thousand strings of fines owed to the Court of Judicial Review were remitted.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，贈強霓、強震官，立廟西和州，賜名旌忠。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the bingshen day, posthumous offices were granted to Qiang Ni and Qiang Zhen; a temple was erected in Xihe Prefecture and named Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the bingshen day, posthumous offices were granted to Qiang Ni and Qiang Zhen; a temple was built in Xihe Prefecture and given the name Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，限四川總領會子額。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, quotas were set on huizi notes issued by the Sichuan overall manager.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, limits were placed on the volume of huizi notes issued by the Sichuan overall manager.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，罷興州都統司營田官兵，募民耕佃。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the garrison farmland troops of the Xingzhou commander-in-chief's office were disbanded and civilians were recruited to cultivate the fields as tenants.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the garrison farmland troops of the Xingzhou commander-in-chief's office were disbanded, and civilians were recruited to farm the land as tenants.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復分利州東、西路爲二。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Lizhou East and West circuits were again divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Lizhou East and West circuits were again split into two circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，置鎮江、建康府轉般倉。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, transfer warehouses were established at Zhenjiang and Jiankang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, transfer granaries were established at Zhenjiang and Jiankang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 龔茂良卒于英州。

translations.literal: Gong Maoliang died at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Maoliang died at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以魏王愷爲永興、成德軍節度使、雍州牧、判明州如故。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Prince of Wei Zhao Kai was again appointed Military Commissioner of Yongxing and Chengde armies, Governor of Yongzhou, and Administrator of Mingzhou as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Prince of Wei Zhao Kai was again appointed Military Commissioner of the Yongxing and Chengde armies, Governor of Yongzhou, and Administrator of Mingzhou, as before.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，蠲秀州民折帛錢。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, the bolt-silk conversion payment owed by the people of Xiuzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the bolt-silk conversion payments owed by the people of Xiuzhou were remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，太尉、提舉萬壽觀李顯忠薨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiazi day, Grand Marshal and Director of the Longevity Abbey Li Xianzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiazi day, Grand Marshal and Director of the Longevity Abbey Li Xianzhong died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，禁砂毛錢。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, debased sand-furred coin was banned.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, debased sand-furred coin was banned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以歲豐，命沿江糴米百六十萬石，以廣邊儲。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, because the harvest was abundant, the provinces along the Yangzi were ordered to purchase 1.6 million shi of rice to expand frontier granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because the harvest was abundant, the Yangzi provinces were ordered to buy 1.6 million shi of rice to enlarge frontier reserves.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，詔諸路監司戒所部，民稅毋以重價強折輸錢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, an edict admonished circuit supervisory commissioners to warn their jurisdictions that grain taxes must not be forcibly commuted to cash at inflated rates.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, an edict warned circuit supervisory commissioners to instruct their jurisdictions not to force grain tax payments into cash at inflated conversion rates.

sentences.zh: 復製科舊法。

translations.literal: The former regulations for the special examination category were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The former regulations for the special examination category were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔關外四州增募民兵爲忠勇軍。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, an edict ordered the four prefectures beyond the pass to recruit additional militia as the Loyal-and-Brave Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict ordered the four prefectures beyond the pass to recruit additional militia into the Loyal-and-Brave Army.

sentences.zh: 戊午，增銓試爲五場，呈試爲四場。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the qualification examination was increased to five sessions and the presentation examination to four.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the qualification examination was expanded to five sessions and the presentation examination to four.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，定廣西賣鹽賞罰。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, rewards and penalties for Guangxi salt sales were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, rewards and penalties for Guangxi salt sales were established.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸秘書省。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the emperor visited the Secretariat Archives.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the emperor visited the Secretariat Archives.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜岳飛諡曰武穆。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Yue Fei was granted the posthumous title Martial and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yue Fei was granted the posthumous title Martial and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，史浩等上《三祖下第六世仙源類譜》、《仁宗玉牒》。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the wuxu day, Shi Hao and others presented the 《Genealogical Compendium of the Sixth Generation below the Three Ancestors》 and the 《Imperial Register of Renzong》.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the wuxu day, Shi Hao and others presented the 《Genealogical Compendium of the Sixth Generation below the Three Ancestors》 and the 《Imperial Register of Emperor Renzong》.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣宇文價等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Yu Wen Jia and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Yu Wen Jia and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金遣張九思等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Jin dispatched Zhang Jiusi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Jin dispatched Zhang Jiusi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，奉國軍節度使、殿前都指揮使王友直以募兵擾民，降爲武甯軍承宣使，罷軍職，統制以下奪官有差。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Palace Front commander-in-chief Wang Youzhi, for recruiting troops that harassed the people, was demoted to Military Commandant of Wuning Army, stripped of his army post, and regimental commanders and below had their offices reduced by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army and Palace Front commander-in-chief Wang Youzhi, because the troops he recruited had harassed the people, was demoted to Military Commandant of Wuning Army, stripped of his army command, and regimental commanders and below were reduced in rank to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 軍民嘩呶者，執送大理寺鞫之。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians who clamored were seized and sent to the Court of Judicial Review for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians who raised an uproar were seized and sent to the Court of Judicial Review for trial.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以孫右千牛衛大將軍擴爲明州觀察使，封英國公。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Sun You, Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, was made Observation Commissioner of Mingzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Sun You, Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, was made Observation Commissioner of Mingzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，詔軍民喧哄者，並從軍法。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin day, an edict ordered that clamoring soldiers and civilians alike be punished under military law.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin day, an edict ordered that soldiers and civilians who raised a clamor alike be punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 史浩言民不宜律以軍法，不聽。

translations.literal: Shi Hao said civilians should not be judged by military law; the emperor did not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hao argued that civilians should not be judged under military law, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 王友直再降爲宜州觀察使、信州居住。

translations.literal: Wang Youzhi was demoted again to Observation Commissioner of Yizhou and ordered to reside at Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youzhi was demoted again to Observation Commissioner of Yizhou and ordered to reside at Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 浩請罷政。

translations.literal: Hao requested to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Hao asked to resign from government.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，浩罷爲少傅，還舊節，充醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Hao was dismissed and made Junior Tutor, restored to his former command, and appointed Commissioner of Liquor Spring Abbey with concurrent duty as imperial reader.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Hao was dismissed and made Junior Tutor, restored to his former command, and appointed Commissioner of Liquor Spring Abbey with concurrent duty as imperial reader.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以錢良臣參知政事。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Qian Liangchen was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Qian Liangchen was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以趙雄爲右丞相，王淮爲樞密使。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Zhao Xiong was made Right Chief Minister and Wang Huai Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Zhao Xiong was made Right Chief Minister and Wang Huai Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以兩川禁卒千人爲成都府雄邊軍。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, one thousand garrison troops from the Two Sichuan circuits were formed into the Chengdu Frontier Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, one thousand garrison troops from the Two Sichuan circuits were formed into the Chengdu Frontier Army.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，復監司互察法。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the mutual oversight law for supervisory commissioners was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the mutual oversight law for circuit supervisory commissioners was restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅朔，班新定薦舉式。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the new moon day gengyin, the newly fixed recommendation formats were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon day gengyin, the newly fixed recommendation formats were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣錢沖之等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Qian Chongzhi and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Qian Chongzhi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷興元都統司營田官兵，募民耕佃。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the garrison farmland troops of the Xingyuan commander-in-chief's office were disbanded and civilians recruited as tenants.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the garrison farmland troops of the Xingyuan commander-in-chief's office were disbanded, and civilians were recruited to farm the land as tenants.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復同安、蘄春監。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Tong'an and Qichun salt offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Tong'an and Qichun salt offices were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁兩淮銅錢，復行鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, copper coin was banned in the Two Huai regions and iron coin was put back in circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, copper coin was banned in the Two Huai regions and iron coin was put back into circulation.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金遣烏延察等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Jin dispatched Wuyancha and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Jin dispatched Wuyancha and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，階、福建興化軍水，通、泰、楚州、高郵軍田鼠傷禾。

translations.literal: That year, Jie and Xinghua Military Prefecture in Fujian suffered flooding; field mice damaged grain in Tong, Tai, Chuzhou, and Gaoyou Military Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Jie and Xinghua Military Prefecture in Fujian were flooded, and field mice damaged the grain crop in Tong, Tai, Chuzhou, and Gaoyou Military Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三佛齊國入貢。

translations.literal: The state of Srivijaya sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Srivijaya sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊辰，振淮東饑民。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year, on the wuchen day of the first month, famine victims in eastern Huai were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on the first month's wuchen day, famine victims in eastern Huai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復置內侍省合同憑由司。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the Palace Domestic Service contract and credential office was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Palace Domestic Service contract and credential office was re-established.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲夔州路上供金銀。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the gold and silver tribute from the Kuizhou circuit was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the gold and silver tribute from the Kuizhou circuit was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復置光州中渡榷場。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the Zhongdu licensed market at Guangzhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Zhongdu licensed market at Guangzhou was restored.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑朔，幸佑聖觀，召史浩、曾覿賜酒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day jichou, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey and summoned Shi Hao and Zeng Di to be granted wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon day jichou, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey and summoned Shi Hao and Zeng Di to be granted wine.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，錢良臣以失舉贓吏，奪三官，丙申，詔前宰執、侍從有己見利便，聽不時以聞，辛丑，立武臣關升蔭補法。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Qian Liangchen was stripped of three ranks for having failed to detect a corrupt clerk. On the bingshen day, an edict allowed former chief ministers and attendant officials who had proposals of their own on beneficial measures to report them at any time without waiting for a regular audience. On the xinchou day, regulations were established for military officials' promotion by inherited privilege.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Qian Liangchen was stripped of three ranks for having failed to expose a corrupt clerk. On the bingshen day, an edict allowed former chief ministers and attendant officials who had proposals of their own on beneficial measures to report them at any time. On the xinchou day, regulations were established for military officials' promotion through inherited privilege.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔逃軍犯強盜者毋擬貸。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered that deserters who committed robbery were not to be considered for leniency.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered that deserters who committed robbery were not to be considered for leniency.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: On the guichou day.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day.

sentences.zh: 命州縣毋撓義役。

translations.literal: An order required prefectures and counties not to obstruct voluntary labor service.
translations.idiomatic: An order required prefectures and counties not to obstruct voluntary labor service.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔自今歸正官親赴部授官，以革冒濫。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict required that from now on restored officials must personally go to the ministry to receive appointments, in order to curb fraudulent abuse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, an edict required that from now on restored officials must personally go to the ministry to receive appointments, in order to curb fraudulent abuse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，裁特奏名試法。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the special-imperial-name examination regulations were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the special imperial-name examination regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the gengshen day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，錄趙鼎、岳飛子孫，賜以京秩。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the descendants of Zhao Ding and Yue Fei were entered on the rolls and granted capital appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the descendants of Zhao Ding and Yue Fei were entered on the rolls and granted capital appointments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，郴州賊陳峒等破連、道州、桂陽軍諸縣，命湖南帥臣討捕之。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, the bandits Chen Dong and others of Chenzhou attacked several counties in Lian, Dao, and Guiyang Military Prefectures; the commander of Hunan was ordered to hunt them down.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the bandit Chen Dong and others of Chenzhou overran counties in Lian, Dao, and Guiyang Military Prefectures; the Hunan commander was ordered to pursue and capture them.

sentences.zh: 置廣西義倉。

translations.literal: Charity granaries were established in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Charity granaries were established in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，再振淮東饑民。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, famine victims in eastern Huai were relieved again.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, famine victims in eastern Huai were relieved again.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔戒勵諸道轉運使。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict admonished and encouraged the transport commissioners of the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict admonished and encouraged the transport commissioners of the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戎，裁宗室換官法。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the renxu day, the regulations on office exchanges for imperial clansmen were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on the renxu day, the regulations on office exchanges for imperial clansmen were revised.

sentences.zh: 庚午，蠲四川鹽課十萬緡。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, one hundred thousand strings of Sichuan's salt levy were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, one hundred thousand strings of Sichuan's salt levy were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，郴寇平。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Chenzhou rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Chenzhou rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸未，給襄陽歸正忠義人田。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, farmland was granted to the loyal-and-righteous repatriates at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, farmland was allotted to the loyal-and-righteous repatriates at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，建豐儲倉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, the Abundant Storage granary was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, the Abundant Storage granary was built.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔特奏名毋授知縣、縣令。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, an edict forbade appointing special imperial-name graduates as prefects or county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, an edict forbade appointing special imperial-name graduates as prefects or county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，蠲郴州運糧丁夫今年役錢之半。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, half the year's corvée payments for Chenzhou grain-transport laborers were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, half the year's corvée payments owed by Chenzhou grain-transport laborers were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，廣西妖賊李接破郁林州，守臣李端卿棄城遁，遂圍化州。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the sorcerer-rebel Li Jie of Guangxi stormed Yulin Prefecture; defending official Li Duanqing abandoned the city and fled, then besieged Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Guangxi sorcerer-rebel Li Jie overran Yulin Prefecture; defending official Li Duanqing abandoned the city and fled, then laid siege to Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 命經略司討捕之。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission was ordered to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commission was ordered to pursue and capture them.

sentences.zh: 端卿除名勒停、梅州編管。

translations.literal: Duanqing was stripped of name and office, dismissed, and assigned to supervised residence at Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duanqing was stripped of name and office, dismissed, and placed under supervised residence at Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，籍郴州降寇。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guihai day, surrendered bandits of Chenzhou were registered.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guihai day, surrendered Chenzhou bandits were registered.

sentences.zh: 隸荊、鄂軍。

translations.literal: They were assigned to the Jing and E armies.
translations.idiomatic: They were assigned to the Jing and E armies.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，班《隆興以來寬恤詔令》于諸路。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, the 《Edicts of Clemency since Longxing》 were promulgated to the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the 《Edicts of Clemency since Longxing》 were promulgated to the circuits.

sentences.zh: 趙雄等上《會要》。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiong and others presented the 《Institutional Compendium》.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiong and others presented the 《Institutional Compendium》.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔諸軍五口以上增給緡錢。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, an edict ordered additional cash grants for households of five or more in the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict ordered additional cash grants for army households of five members or more.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Venus was visible in daylight and traversed the sky.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，罷諸路監司、帥守便宜行事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, the discretionary authority of circuit supervisory commissioners and military prefects was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, the discretionary authority of circuit supervisory commissioners and military prefects was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以知楚州翟畋過淮生事，奪五官、筠州居住。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Zhai Tian, prefect of Chuzhou, for causing trouble by crossing the Huai, was stripped of five ranks and ordered to reside at Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Zhai Tian, prefect of Chuzhou, for causing trouble by crossing the Huai, was stripped of five ranks and ordered to reside at Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the xinwei day, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinwei day, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔福建、二廣賣鹽毋擅增舊額。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, an edict forbade Fujian and the Two Guang from unilaterally increasing their former salt-sale quotas.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, an edict forbade Fujian and the Two Guang from unilaterally raising their former salt-sale quotas.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，蠲連州被寇民租稅。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the new moon day yiyou, rent and tax of the people of Lianzhou who had suffered bandit raids were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the tenth month's new moon day yiyou, rent and tax owed by the people of Lianzhou who had suffered bandit raids were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣陳峴等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Chen Xian and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Chen Xian and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔太學兩優釋褐，與殿試第二人恩例。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, an edict granted imperial-academy double-excellence graduates office at first appointment with the same favor as the second-place palace examination graduate.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, an edict granted imperial-academy double-excellence graduates office at first appointment with the same privileges as the second-place palace examination graduate.

sentences.zh: 庚子，四川行當三大錢。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Sichuan put into circulation the large three-cash coin.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Sichuan put the large three-cash coin into circulation.

sentences.zh: 再蠲四川鹽課十七萬餘緡。

translations.literal: Sichuan's salt levy was again remitted by more than one hundred seventy thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's salt levy was again cut by more than one hundred seventy thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，除紹興府民逋賦五萬餘緡。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, more than fifty thousand strings of arrears owed by the people of Shaoxing Prefecture were cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, more than fifty thousand strings of tax arrears owed by the people of Shaoxing Prefecture were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金遣蒲察鼎壽等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Jin dispatched Pucha Dingshou and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Jin dispatched Pucha Dingshou and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 戊申，廣西妖賊平。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, the Guangxi sorcerer-rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the Guangxi sorcerer-rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，帝著論數百言，深原用人之弊，因及誅賞之法，命宰執示從臣於都堂。

translations.literal: On the new moon day yimao in the eleventh month, the emperor composed a discourse of several hundred words deeply analyzing the defects in the employment of men, extending also to the methods of punishment and reward, and ordered the chief ministers to display it to attendant officials in the Executive Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's new moon day yimao, the emperor wrote a discourse of several hundred words probing the defects in how men were employed and extending to the methods of punishment and reward, and ordered the chief ministers to show it to attendant officials in the Executive Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，裁宗子試法。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the imperial-clansmen examination regulations were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the examination regulations for imperial clansmen were revised.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷金州管內安撫司。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the Jinzhou intra-circuit pacification commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the Jinzhou intra-circuit pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔宗室有出身人得考試及注教授官。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, an edict allowed clansmen with formal status to take examinations and receive appointments including instructor posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict allowed clansmen with formal status to take examinations and receive appointments, including instructor posts.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣傅淇等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Fu Qi and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Fu Qi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，班《重修淳熙敕令格式》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, the 《Revised Chunxi Statutes, Commands, and Formats》 were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, the 《Revised Chunxi Statutes, Commands, and Formats》 were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丙申，修百司省記法。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the digest law for the hundred offices was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the digest law for the hundred offices was revised.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔自今鞫贓吏，後雖原貸者，毋以失入坐獄官。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, an edict ordered that from now on when trying corrupt officials, even if later pardoned, trial officials were not to be punished on grounds of wrongful conviction.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, an edict ordered that from now on, when trying corrupt officials, even if the offenders were later pardoned, trial officials were not to be punished for wrongful conviction.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金遣耶律慥等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Jin dispatched Yelü Zhao and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Jin dispatched Yelü Zhao and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，蠲臨安府徵稅一年。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Lin'an Prefecture's levied taxes were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Lin'an Prefecture's levied taxes were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，溫、台州水，和州旱。

translations.literal: That year, Wen and Taizhou suffered flooding, and Hezhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Wen and Taizhou were flooded, and Hezhou suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲子，減廣西諸州歲賣鹽數。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year, on the jiazi day of the first month, the annual salt-sale quotas of Guangxi prefectures were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on the first month's jiazi day, the annual salt-sale quotas of Guangxi prefectures were reduced.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，劉焞以以平李接功，擢集英殿修撰，將佐幕屬吏士進官、減磨勘年有差。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Liu Hun, for merit in pacifying Li Jie, was promoted to Compiler at the Hall for Advancing Excellence; generals, aides, staff, and clerks received promotions and reduced merit-review years in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Liu Hun, for merit in pacifying Li Jie, was promoted to Compiler at the Hall for Advancing Excellence; generals, aides, staff, and clerks received promotions and reduced merit-review years to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔京西州軍並用鐵錢及會子；

translations.literal: On the jimao day, an edict ordered Jingxi prefectures and garrisons to use iron coin and huizi notes alike;
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict ordered Jingxi prefectures and garrisons to use both iron coin and huizi notes;

sentences.zh: 民戶銅錢，以鐵錢或會子償之，滿二月不輸官，許告賞。

translations.literal: households' copper coin was to be redeemed in iron coin or huizi notes; those who failed to surrender it to the government within two months were subject to informer rewards.
translations.idiomatic: households' copper coin was to be redeemed in iron coin or huizi notes; those who failed to surrender it to the government within two months could be reported for reward.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲淮東民貸常平錢米。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, eastern Huai people's loans of Ever-Normal granary cash and grain were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, eastern Huai people's loans of Ever-Normal granary cash and grain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未朔，初置廣南煙瘴諸州醫官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day guiwei, medical officers were first established in the miasmic prefectures of southern Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon day guiwei, medical officers were first established in the miasmic prefectures of southern Guang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復置皇太子宮小學教授。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the elementary-school instructor for the Heir Apparent's palace was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the elementary-school instructor for the Heir Apparent's palace was re-established.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，魏王愷薨。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Prince of Wei Zhao Kai died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Prince of Wei Zhao Kai died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔撥廣西兵校五百人隸提刑司。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, an edict ordered five hundred Guangxi military clerks assigned to the judicial-intendant office.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, an edict assigned five hundred Guangxi military clerks to the judicial-intendant office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，罷瓜洲孳生馬監。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the Guazhou horse-breeding stud was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the Guazhou horse-breeding stud was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，出湖南樁積米十萬石，振糶永、邵、郴三州。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, one hundred thousand shi of stored grain from Hunan was released to relieve and sell grain in Yong, Shao, and Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, one hundred thousand shi of stored grain from Hunan was released to relieve and sell grain in Yong, Shao, and Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命利州路守、貳、縣令兼領營田。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, prefects, vice-prefects, and county magistrates of Lizhou Circuit were ordered concurrently to oversee garrison farmland.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, prefects, vice-prefects, and county magistrates of Lizhou Circuit were ordered to oversee garrison farmland concurrently.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，限改官員歲毋過八十人。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, a limit was set that no more than eighty officials per year might change office by special procedure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, a limit was set that no more than eighty officials per year might change office by special procedure.

sentences.zh: 封子楝爲宜州觀察使、安定郡王。

translations.literal: Zhao Dong was enfeoffed as Observation Commissioner of Yizhou and Prince of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dong was enfeoffed as Observation Commissioner of Yizhou and Prince of Anding Commandery.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，詔舉賢良方正能直言極諫者。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the renxu day, an edict called for recommendations of worthy and upright men able to speak bluntly and remonstrate forcefully.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renxu day, an edict called for recommendations of worthy and upright men able to speak bluntly and remonstrate forcefully.

sentences.zh: 庚午，迎太上皇、太上皇后宴翠寒堂。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress were received for a banquet at Emerald Cold Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress were received for a banquet at Emerald Cold Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，減內外官薦舉員。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the number of recommendation slots for inner- and outer-court officials was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the number of recommendation slots for inner- and outer-court officials was reduced.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，再蠲臨安府民身丁錢三年，詔諸州招補軍籍之闕，自今歲以爲常。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Lin'an Prefecture people's poll-tax payments were again remitted for three years; an edict ordered the various prefectures to recruit replacements for vacancies in military registers, to be regular practice from this year onward.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Lin'an Prefecture people's poll-tax payments were again remitted for three years; an edict ordered the prefectures to recruit replacements for vacancies in military registers, making this regular practice from this year onward.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiashen day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiashen day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，趙雄等上仁宗、哲宗玉牒。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Zhao Xiong and others presented the imperial registers of Emperors Renzong and Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Zhao Xiong and others presented the imperial registers of Emperors Renzong and Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，除明州積欠諸司錢十五萬緡。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, one hundred fifty thousand strings of long-overdue payments owed by Mingzhou to the various offices were cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, one hundred fifty thousand strings of long-overdue payments owed by Mingzhou to the various offices were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，再免沿邊歸正人請占官田賦役三年，甲辰，黎州五部落犯盤佗砦，兵馬都監高晃以綿、潼大軍三千人與戰，敗走，蠻人深入，大掠而去。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, frontier repatriates who had requested official farmland were again exempted from tax and corvée for three years. On the jiachen day, the Five Tribes of Lizhou attacked Pantuo Stockade; Military Inspector Gao Huang fought them with three thousand troops from Mian and Tong, was defeated and fled, and the barbarians penetrated deep and plundered heavily before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, frontier repatriates who had requested official farmland were again exempted from tax and corvée for three years. On the jiachen day, the Five Tribes of Lizhou attacked Pantuo Stockade; Military Inspector Gao Huang fought them with three thousand troops from Mian and Tong, was defeated and fled, and the tribes penetrated deep, plundered heavily, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命蔭補、武舉、宗室、小使臣行三年喪。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, appointees by inherited privilege, military-examination graduates, imperial clansmen, and junior commissioners were ordered to observe three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, appointees by inherited privilege, military-examination graduates, imperial clansmen, and junior commissioners were ordered to observe three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，以吏部尚書周必大參知政事，刑部尚書謝廓然簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuchen day, Minister of Personnel Zhou Bida was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Minister of Justice Xie Kuoran was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuchen day, Minister of Personnel Zhou Bida was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Minister of Justice Xie Kuoran was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 袁州分宜縣大水，捐其稅。

translations.literal: Fenyi County in Yuanzhou suffered great flooding, and its taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fenyi County in Yuanzhou suffered severe flooding, and its taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔舒、蘄二州鑄錢歲以四十五萬貫爲額。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, an edict set the annual coin-casting quota for Shu and Qi prefectures at four hundred fifty thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an edict set the annual coin-casting quota for Shu and Qi prefectures at four hundred fifty thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 己卯，申飭書坊擅刻書籍之禁。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the prohibition on bookshops' unauthorized printing of books was strictly reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the prohibition on bookshops' unauthorized printing of books was strictly reinforced.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔特奏名年六十人毋注縣尉。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, an edict forbade appointing special imperial-name graduates aged sixty or older as county constables.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict forbade appointing special imperial-name graduates aged sixty or older as county constables.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，以特進、觀文殿大學士、判建康府陳俊卿爲少保。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingxu day, Special Courtier, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, and Administrator of Jiankang Chen Junqing was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingxu day, Special Courtier, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, and Administrator of Jiankang Chen Junqing was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，五部落再犯黎州，制置司鈐轄成光延戰敗，官軍死者甚衆，提點刑獄、權州事折知常棄城遁。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, the Five Tribes again attacked Lizhou; Pacification Commission Controller Cheng Guangyan was defeated in battle, many government troops died, and Judicial Intendant and Acting Prefect Zhe Zhichang abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the Five Tribes again attacked Lizhou; Pacification Commission Controller Cheng Guangyan was defeated, many government troops were killed, and Judicial Intendant and Acting Prefect Zhe Zhichang abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 甲午，制置司益兵，遣都大提舉茶馬吳總往平之。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the Pacification Commission reinforced its troops and dispatched Tea-and-Horse Overall Commissioner Wu Zong to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the Pacification Commission reinforced its troops and dispatched Tea-and-Horse Overall Commissioner Wu Zong to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔試刑法官增試經義。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict ordered judicial officials under examination to add a test in classical meaning.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict ordered judicial officials under examination to add a test in classical meaning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，詔二廣帥臣、監司察所部守臣臧否以聞。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guichou day, an edict ordered military commanders and supervisory commissioners of the Two Guang to investigate the merit and faults of prefectural officials under them and report.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guichou day, an edict ordered military commanders and supervisory commissioners of the Two Guang to investigate the merit and faults of prefectural officials under them and report upward.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以旱，決系囚，分命群臣禱雨於山川。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, because of drought, detained prisoners were judged and ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain at mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, because of drought, detained prisoners were judged and ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain at mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 壬申，移廣西提刑司于郁林州。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the Guangxi judicial-intendant office was moved to Yulin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the Guangxi judicial-intendant office was moved to Yulin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，禁黎州官吏市蕃商物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the guiwei day, Lizhou officials were forbidden to buy goods from tribal merchants.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guiwei day, Lizhou officials were forbidden to buy goods from tribal merchants.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以禱雨未應，諭輔臣欲令職事官以上各實封言事。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, because prayers for rain had not been answered, the emperor instructed the chief ministers that he wished officials with substantive duties and above each to submit sealed memorials on public affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, because prayers for rain had gone unanswered, the emperor told the chief ministers that he wished officials with substantive duties and above each to submit sealed memorials on public affairs.

sentences.zh: 是夕，雨。

translations.literal: That evening, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，置湖南飛虎軍。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the Flying Tiger Army of Hunan was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the Flying Tiger Army of Hunan was established.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雨。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，五部落犯黎州塞，興州左軍統領王去惡拒卻之，折知常重賂蠻，使之納款。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the Five Tribes attacked the Lizhou frontier pass; Left Army Commander Wang Que of Xingzhou repelled them, and Zhe Zhichang heavily bribed the tribes to make them submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the Five Tribes attacked the Lizhou frontier pass; Left Army Commander Wang Que of Xingzhou repelled them, and Zhe Zhichang heavily bribed the tribes until they submitted.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔自今常朝毋稱丞相名。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, an edict ordered that from now on at regular court audiences the chief minister's name was not to be spoken.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, an edict ordered that from now on at regular court audiences the chief minister's name was not to be spoken aloud.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命樞密使亦如之。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the Military Affairs Commissioner was ordered to be treated likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Military Affairs Commissioner was ordered to be treated likewise.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔宰執、使相，給使減年恩數，身後三年者毋收使。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, an edict ordered that for chief ministers and commissioners with ceremonial seals, the number of years by which attendant-service reduced mourning favor was to be cut, and that for those dead three years or more, attendant-service was not to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, an edict regulated mourning favors for chief ministers and commissioners with ceremonial seals, reducing the years counted for attendant-service and forbidding collection of attendant-service for those dead three years or more.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔知縣成資始聽監司薦舉。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, an edict allowed prefectural magistrates who had completed their probation to receive recommendations from supervisory commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, an edict allowed prefectural magistrates who had completed their probation to receive recommendations from supervisory commissioners.

sentences.zh: 壬申，禁諸路遏糴。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the various circuits were forbidden to obstruct grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the circuits were forbidden to obstruct grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，名省記法爲《淳熙重修百司法》。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the digest law was named the 《Chunxi Revised Digest of the Hundred Offices》.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the digest law was named the 《Chunxi Revised Digest of the Hundred Offices》.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，詔：「限田太寬，民役煩重，其令台諫、給舍同戶部長貳詳議以聞。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the bingxu day, an edict stated: "The land limits are too broad and the people's corvée burdens too heavy; let the censorate, remonstrance bureau, and investigating censors together with the senior and junior ministers of the Household Section deliberate in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the bingxu day, an edict stated: "The land limits are too broad and the people's corvée burdens too heavy; let the censorate, remonstrance bureau, and investigating censors together with the senior and junior ministers of the Household Section deliberate in detail and report upward."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，遣葉宏等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Ye Hong and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Ye Hong and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 乙未，黎州五部落進馬乞降，詔卻獻馬，許其互市。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the Five Tribes of Lizhou presented horses and sought to submit; an edict declined the horses but permitted border trade.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the Five Tribes of Lizhou presented horses and sought to submit; an edict declined the horses but permitted border trade.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金遣李佾等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Jin dispatched Li Yi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Jin dispatched Li Yi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，詔邊吏存恤江西過淮饑民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the guichou day, an edict ordered frontier officials to care for famine victims from Jiangxi crossing the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guichou day, an edict ordered frontier officials to care for famine victims from Jiangxi crossing the Huai.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，禁淮南諸司、州郡抑配民酒。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the various offices and prefectures of Huainan were forbidden to force allocation of wine levies on the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the various offices and prefectures of Huainan were forbidden to force allocation of wine levies on the people.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蠲兩淮州軍二稅一年。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the two tax payments of the Two Huai prefectures and garrisons were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the two tax payments of the Two Huai prefectures and garrisons were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，黎州戍軍伍進等作亂，折知常遁去，王去惡誘進等誅之。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Lizhou garrison soldiers Wu Jin and others mutinied; Zhe Zhichang fled, and Wang Que lured Jin and the others and had them executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Lizhou garrison soldiers Wu Jin and others mutinied; Zhe Zhichang fled, and Wang Que lured Jin and the others out and had them executed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，南康軍旱，詔出檢放所余苗米萬石充軍糧。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Nankang Military Prefecture suffered drought; an edict ordered ten thousand shi of seed grain remaining from inspection and release to be issued as army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Nankang Military Prefecture suffered drought; an edict ordered ten thousand shi of seed grain remaining from inspection and release to be issued as army provisions.

sentences.zh: 癸酉。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day.

sentences.zh: 遣蓋經等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Gai Jing and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Jing and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，趙雄等上神宗、哲宗、徽宗、欽宗四朝《國史志》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the gengyin day, Zhao Xiong and others presented the 《National History Monographs》 of the four reigns of Shenzong, Zhezong, Huizong, and Qinzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengyin day, Zhao Xiong and others presented the 《National History Monographs》 of the four reigns of Emperors Shenzong, Zhezong, Huizong, and Qinzong.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以四川制置使胡元質不備蕃部，致其猖獗，奪兩官罷之。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, because Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Hu Yuanzhi had not prepared against the tribal departments and caused them to run rampant, two ranks were stripped and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, because Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Hu Yuanzhi had failed to prepare against the tribal departments and allowed them to run rampant, he was stripped of two ranks and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，嗣濮王士輵薨。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, Heir to Prince of Pu Zhao Shiyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Heir to Prince of Pu Zhao Shiyu died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以新除成都府路提點刑獄祿東之權四川制置司，應黎州邊事，隨宜措置。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the newly appointed Judicial Intendant of Chengdu Circuit Lu Dongzhi was given acting authority over the Sichuan Pacification Commission to handle Lizhou frontier affairs and take measures as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the newly appointed Judicial Intendant of Chengdu Circuit Lu Dongzhi was given acting authority over the Sichuan Pacification Commission to handle Lizhou frontier affairs and take measures as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔臨安府承宣旨審奏如故事。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, an edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture, when receiving and proclaiming imperial edicts, to examine and memorialize according to former practice.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture, when receiving and proclaiming imperial edicts, to examine and memorialize according to former practice.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金遣徒單守素等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Jin dispatched Tushan Shousu and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Jin dispatched Tushan Shousu and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔以太上皇明年七十有五，議行慶壽禮，太上皇不允，帝進黃金二千兩爲壽。

translations.literal: That month, an edict noted that the Retired Emperor would be seventy-five next year and proposed holding longevity-celebration rites; the Retired Emperor did not consent, and the Emperor offered two thousand taels of gold as a birthday gift.
translations.idiomatic: That month, noting that the Retired Emperor would turn seventy-five the following year, the court proposed longevity-celebration rites; the Retired Emperor declined, and the Emperor presented two thousand taels of gold in congratulation.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、浙、淮西、湖北旱，蠲租，發廩貸給，趣州縣決獄，募富民振濟補官。

translations.literal: That year, Jiang, Zhe, Huai West, and Hubei suffered drought; rents were remitted, granaries were opened for loans and distribution, prefectures and counties were urged to decide cases, and wealthy households were recruited for relief work with official appointment as reward.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck Jiang, Zhe, Huai West, and Hubei; the government remitted rents, opened granaries for loans and distribution, pressed prefectures and counties to clear court dockets, and recruited wealthy households to organize relief in exchange for official posts.

sentences.zh: 故歲雖凶，民無流殍。

translations.literal: Thus although the year was disastrous, the people suffered no starvation refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Despite the year's disasters, no mass famine migration occurred.

sentences.zh: 安南入貢。

translations.literal: Annam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月甲寅，停折知常官、汀州居住。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighth year, on the first month's jiayin day, Zhe Zhichang was suspended from office and ordered to reside in Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year, on the first month's jiayin day, Zhe Zhichang was removed from office and ordered to live in exile at Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔、內侍見帶兵官並與在京宮觀，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict ordered eunuch attendants currently holding military posts to be given capital temple-and-abbey posts, and this was written into law.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict required eunuch attendants who held military commissions to be transferred to capital temple-and-abbey sinecures, and the rule was codified.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔福建歲撥鹽于邵武軍市軍糧。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, an edict ordered Fujian annually to allocate salt to Shaowu Army to purchase army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict directed Fujian to set aside salt each year for Shaowu Army to buy military grain.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，詔去歲旱傷郡縣，以義倉米日給貧民，至閏三月半止。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered drought-stricken prefectures and counties of last year to daily supply charity-granary rice to the poor until mid-leap third month.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered last year's drought-hit prefectures and counties to issue charity-granary rice daily to the poor through mid-leap third month.

sentences.zh: 黎州土丁張百祥等不堪科役爲亂，統領官劉大年引兵逆擊之，土丁潰去，大年坐誅。

translations.literal: At Lizhou, native militiamen Zhang Baixiang and others, unable to bear corvée exactions, rebelled; Commander Liu Danian led troops to counterattack; the native militia scattered and fled; Liu Danian was executed.
translations.idiomatic: At Lizhou, native militiamen led by Zhang Baixiang rebelled under the burden of corvée levies; Commander Liu Danian led troops to counterattack, the militia broke and fled, and Liu Danian was put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁浙西民因旱置圍田者。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Western-Zhe people who because of drought had created polder fields were forbidden to do so.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, drought-driven polder reclamation by people in Western Zhe was banned.

sentences.zh: 裁童子試法。

translations.literal: The child-examination regulations were trimmed.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations governing child examinations were revised downward.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁廣西諸州科賣亭戶食鹽。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Guangxi prefectures were forbidden to levy compulsory sale of salt on saltern households.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Guangxi prefectures were forbidden to force saltern households to buy salt under levy.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔三省、樞密、六部置籍，稽考興利除害等事。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered the Three Departments, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Six Ministries to keep registers and audit matters of promoting benefit and removing harm.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict required the Three Departments, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Six Ministries to maintain registers and review measures that advanced public benefit or removed public harm.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以保康軍節度使士歆爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Military Commissioner of Baokang Army Zhao Shixin was made Heir to Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Military Commissioner of Baokang Army Zhao Shixin was installed as Heir to Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未朔，幸佑聖觀。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the dingwei first day of the month, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the month's dingwei day, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以潮州賊沈師爲亂，趣帥、憲捕之。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, because the Chaozhou bandit Shen Shi had risen in rebellion, military commissioners and surveillance commissioners were urgently ordered to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, with the Chaozhou rebel Shen Shi in revolt, route commanders and surveillance commissioners were urgently ordered to arrest him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，命諸路帥臣、監司分州郡臧否爲三等，歲終來上。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the xinsi day, route military commanders and supervisory commissioners were ordered to grade prefectures and commanderies as good, middling, or bad in three tiers and submit reports at year's end.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the xinsi day, route commanders and supervisory commissioners were ordered to rank their prefectures and commanderies in three grades of merit and submit the lists at year's end.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜禮部進士黃由以下三百七十有九人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Huang You of the Ministry of Rites and three hundred seventy-nine others were granted passed the examinations and originations.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Huang You of the Ministry of Rites and three hundred seventy-nine others received jinshi degrees and originations.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，修揚州城。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Yangzhou's city walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Yangzhou's city walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，減在京及諸路房廊錢什之三，德壽宮所減，月以南庫錢貼進。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, shop-rent payments in the capital and on all circuits were reduced by three-tenths; reductions at Deshou Palace were to be offset monthly with southern-warehouse funds submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, building-lease taxes in the capital and on all circuits were cut by thirty percent; shortfalls at Deshou Palace were to be made up each month from the southern treasury.

sentences.zh: 禁潭、道等州官賣鹽。

translations.literal: Official sale of salt in Tan, Dao, and other prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Government salt sales in Tan, Dao, and other prefectures were banned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立宗室命繼法。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the imperial-clan succession-by-order law was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, a law governing succession by appointment within the imperial clan was enacted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，修湖南諸州城。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the guichou day, city walls of Hunan prefectures were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the guichou day, city walls throughout Hunan were repaired.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以臨安疫，分命醫官診視軍民。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, because of plague in Lin'an, medical officers were dispatched separately to examine soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, with plague in Lin'an, medical officers were sent out separately to treat soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復以強盜配隸諸軍重役。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, robbers were again assigned to heavy labor in the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, convicted robbers were again assigned to heavy labor in the guard armies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，安定郡王子棟薨。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Prince of Anding Commandery Zhao Dong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Prince of Anding Commandery Zhao Dong died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，立郴州宜章、桂陽軍臨武縣學，以教養峒民子弟。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, county schools were established at Yizhang in Chenzhou and Linwu in Guiyang Army to educate and nurture dong-barbarian youth.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, county schools were founded at Yizhang in Chenzhou and Linwu in Guiyang Army to educate tribal youth from the dong communities.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，詔監司、守令勸課農桑，以奉行勤怠爲賞罰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, an edict ordered supervisory commissioners and prefects and magistrates to encourage farming and sericulture, with rewards and punishments based on diligence or laxity in carrying this out.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, an edict ordered circuit supervisors and prefectural and county officials to promote farming and sericulture, with rewards and punishments tied to how diligently they did so.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸路轉運司趣民間補葺經界簿籍。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, an edict ordered circuit transport commissioners to urge the people to repair and supplement land-boundary registers and records.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict directed circuit transport commissioners to press the people to repair and update land-boundary registers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以久雨，減京畿及兩浙囚罪一等，釋杖以下，貸貧民稻種錢。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, because of prolonged rain, capital-region and Two-Zhe prisoner sentences were reduced one grade; those below the cane were released; poor people were loaned rice-seed money.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, after prolonged rain, sentences in the capital region and the Two Zhes were reduced one degree; those punishable only by the cane were released, and the poor were lent money for rice seed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以史浩爲少師。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Shi Hao was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Shi Hao was appointed Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，詔放殿前司平江府牧馬草場二萬畝，聽民漁采。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiyou day, an edict released twenty thousand mu of the Palace Front Corps horse pasture in Pingjiang Prefecture, allowing the people to fish and gather there.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiyou day, an edict opened twenty thousand mu of the Palace Front Corps horse pasture in Pingjiang Prefecture for public fishing and foraging.

sentences.zh: 戊午，除淳熙七年諸路旱傷檢放米一百三十七萬石、錢二千六萬緡。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the remitted rice and cash from drought inspections on all circuits in the seventh year of Chunxi were reckoned: one million three hundred seventy thousand piculs of rice and two hundred sixty thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, drought-relief remissions on all circuits in Chunxi 7 were totaled at 1.37 million piculs of rice and 260,000 strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷諸路坊場監官，聽民承買。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, monopoly-shop supervisory officials on all circuits were abolished, and the people were allowed to bid to operate them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, government supervisors of monopoly shops on all circuits were abolished, and private operators were allowed to bid for the franchises.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，史浩薦薛叔似、楊簡、陸九淵、陳謙、葉適、袁燮、趙善譽等十六人，詔並赴都堂審察。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Shi Hao recommended sixteen men including Xue Shusi, Yang Jian, Lu Jiuyuan, Chen Qian, Ye Shi, Yuan Xie, and Zhao Shanyu; an edict ordered them all to undergo review at the imperial hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Shi Hao recommended sixteen scholars including Xue Shusi, Yang Jian, Lu Jiuyuan, Chen Qian, Ye Shi, Yuan Xie, and Zhao Shanyu; an edict summoned them all to imperial review at the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，復以許浦水軍隸殿前司。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the guiwei day, the Xupu Naval Force was again placed under the Palace Front Corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the guiwei day, the Xupu Naval Force was again subordinated to the Palace Front Corps.

sentences.zh: 永陽郡王居廣薨，追封永王。

translations.literal: Prince of Yongyang Commandery Zhao Juguang died; posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yongyang Commandery Zhao Juguang died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Yong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賞監司、守臣修舉荒政者十六人。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, sixteen supervisory commissioners and prefectural officials who had undertaken famine relief were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, sixteen circuit supervisors and prefectural officials who had carried out famine relief were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 以不雨、決系囚。

translations.literal: Because there was no rain, detained prisoners were judged.
translations.idiomatic: Because rain had not fallen, detained prisoners were reviewed and sentenced.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，紹興大水，出秀、婺州、平江府米振糶。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Shaoxing suffered great flooding; rice from Xiuzhou, Wuzhou, and Pingjiang Prefecture was released for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, after severe flooding in Shaoxing, grain from Xiuzhou, Wuzhou, and Pingjiang Prefecture was released for famine sale.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，嚴州水，詔被災之家蠲其和買，三等以上戶減半。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Yanzhou suffered flooding; an edict remitted government-purchase levies for disaster-stricken households, and households of the third grade and above had them halved.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, after flooding in Yanzhou, an edict remitted government-purchase levies for disaster households and halved them for households of third grade and above.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，錄範質後。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, descendants of Fan Zhi were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, descendants of Fan Zhi were entered on the honor roll.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，以旱，罷招軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the bingwu day, because of drought, recruitment of soldiers was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingwu day, drought led to suspension of army recruitment.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙雄罷。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Zhao Xiong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zhao Xiong was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔紹興府諸縣夏稅、和市、折帛、身丁錢絹之類，不以名色，截日並令住催。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, an edict ordered Shaoxing Prefecture's counties, regardless of levy type—summer tax, government purchase, silk-tax conversion, poll tax in cloth and cash, and the like—to cease collection as of the cutoff date.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, an edict ordered Shaoxing Prefecture's counties to halt collection of every levy—summer tax, government purchase, silk-tax conversion, poll tax in cloth and cash, and the like—by the stated deadline.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: On the guichou day.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day.

sentences.zh: 以王淮爲右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Wang Huai was made Right Chief Councillor and concurrently Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
