translations.idiomatic: Wang Huai was appointed Right Chief Councillor and concurrently Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以謝廓然同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Xie Kuoran was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xie Kuoran was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，更後殿幄次爲延和殿。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, the rear-hall tent enclosure was renamed Extended Harmony Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the rear-hall audience enclosure was renamed Extended Harmony Hall.

sentences.zh: 己未，以觀文殿大學士、新四川制置使趙雄知瀘州，戊辰，言者請自今歉歲蠲減，經費有虧，令戶部據實以聞，毋得督趣己蠲閣之數。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and newly appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zhao Xiong was made prefect of Luzhou. On the wuchen day, memorializers requested that from now on, when lean years brought remissions and reductions, any resulting revenue shortfall should be reported truthfully by the Ministry of Revenue and that officials must not press for amounts already remitted or suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and newly appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zhao Xiong was posted as prefect of Luzhou. On the wuchen day, memorializers asked that whenever lean-year remissions created revenue shortfalls, the Ministry of Revenue report the actual figures and that no official press for sums already remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路補葺經界簿籍。

translations.literal: Repair and supplementation of land-boundary registers on all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The project to repair and update land-boundary registers on all circuits was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，命諸路提舉司貸民麥種。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengchen day, circuit intendant offices were ordered to lend wheat seed to the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengchen day, circuit intendant offices were ordered to lend wheat seed to the people.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，錢良臣罷。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Qian Liangchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Qian Liangchen was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以謝廓然兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Xie Kuoran was additionally given acting authority as Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Xie Kuoran was additionally given acting authority as Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，遣施師點等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the jiyou day, Shi Shidian and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the jiyou day, Shi Shidian and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄黎州戰歿將士四百三人。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, four hundred three officers and soldiers killed in battle at Lizhou were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, four hundred three officers and soldiers killed fighting at Lizhou were entered on the honor roll.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金遣完顏寔等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Shi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Shi and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 詔災傷州縣諭民振糶。

translations.literal: An edict ordered disaster-stricken prefectures and counties to instruct the people in relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed drought- and flood-stricken prefectures and counties to organize public relief sales.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，以旱傷，罷喜雪宴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiaxu day, because of drought damage, the Delight-in-Snow banquet was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiaxu day, drought damage led to cancellation of the Delight-in-Snow banquet.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蠲富陽、新城、錢塘夏稅。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, summer taxes of Fuyang, Xincheng, and Qiantang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, summer taxes in Fuyang, Xincheng, and Qiantang were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，前池州守趙粹中誤斬遞卒汪青，落職，仍詔給青家衣糧十五年。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, former prefect of Chizhou Zhao Cuizhong mistakenly executed courier Wang Qing; he was demoted, and an edict additionally granted Wang Qing's family clothing and grain for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, former Chizhou prefect Zhao Cuizhong was demoted for wrongly executing courier Wang Qing; an edict also granted Wang Qing's family clothing and grain for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔兩省、侍從、台諫各舉所知。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered the Two Departments, attendant ministers, and censorate remonstrators each to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered the Two Departments, attendant ministers, and censorate remonstrators each to recommend men of talent they knew.

sentences.zh: 浚行在至鎮江府運河。

translations.literal: The canal from the provisional capital to Zhenjiang Prefecture was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The canal from the provisional capital to Zhenjiang Prefecture was dredged.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣燕世良賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Yan Shiliang was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Yan Shiliang was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 己亥，振臨安府及嚴州饑民。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, starving people in Lin'an Prefecture and Yanzhou were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, famine relief was given to the hungry in Lin'an Prefecture and Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，再詔臨安府爲粥食饑民。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, an edict again ordered Lin'an Prefecture to provide gruel to the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict again ordered Lin'an Prefecture to feed the hungry with gruel kitchens.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以淳熙元年減半推賞法募民振糶。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the halved reward-promotion law of the first year of Chunxi was used to recruit people for relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the half-reward promotion rule of Chunxi 1 was used to recruit people to conduct famine sales.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，以徽、饒二州民流者衆，罷守臣，官出南庫錢三十萬緡，付新浙東提舉常平朱熹振糶。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, guimao, because many people had fled from Huizhou and Raozhou, the prefectural officials were dismissed; the government contributed three hundred thousand strings from the southern warehouse and entrusted newly appointed Eastern-Zhe intendant of the Ever-Normal Granary Zhu Xi with relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's guimao day, with large numbers fleeing Huizhou and Raozhou, the prefectural officials were dismissed; the government allocated three hundred thousand strings from the southern treasury and put newly appointed Eastern-Zhe Ever-Normal intendant Zhu Xi in charge of famine sales.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁諸州營造。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, construction by prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, new construction by prefectures was banned.

sentences.zh: 戊申，諡劉安世曰忠定。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Liu Anshi was posthumously titled Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Liu Anshi was posthumously given the temple name Zhongding.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，蠲諸路旱傷州軍明年身丁錢物。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, next year's poll-tax payments in kind and cash were remitted for drought-stricken prefectures and armies on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, next year's poll-tax payments in kind and cash were remitted for drought-stricken prefectures and military commands on all circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 以度僧牒募閩、廣民入米。

translations.literal: Ordination certificates were used to recruit people in Fujian and Guang to contribute rice.
translations.idiomatic: Ordination certificates were offered to recruit people in Fujian and Guangdong to contribute rice.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔縣令有能舉荒政者，監司、郡守以名聞。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict ordered that when county magistrates were able to undertake famine relief, supervisory commissioners and prefects should report their names.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict ordered circuit supervisors and prefects to report the names of county magistrates who distinguished themselves in famine relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，下朱熹社倉法于諸路。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Zhu Xi's community-granary law was issued to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Zhu Xi's community-granary system was promulgated to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金遣魏貞吉等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Jin dispatched Wei Zhenji and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Jin dispatched Wei Zhenji and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 以爭執進書儀，帝還內，遣王抃往諭旨。

translations.literal: Because of a dispute over protocol for presenting the letter of congratulations, the Emperor withdrew to the inner palace and sent Wang Bian to convey the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: After a dispute over the ceremony for presenting the congratulatory letter, the Emperor withdrew to the inner palace and sent Wang Bian to explain the imperial position.

sentences.zh: 己巳，貞吉奉書入見。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Zhenji presented the letter and was received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Wei Zhenji presented the letter and was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣東安撫鞏湘誘潮賊沈師出降，誅之。

translations.literal: That month, Guangdong Pacification Commissioner Gong Xiang lured the Chaozhou bandit Shen Shi to surrender and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Guangdong Pacification Commissioner Gong Xiang induced the Chaozhou rebel Shen Shi to surrender and then executed him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、浙、兩淮、京西、湖北、潼川、夔州等路水旱相繼，發廩蠲租，遣使按視，民有流入江北者，命所在振業之。

translations.literal: That year, Jiang, Zhe, Two Huai, Jing West, Hubei, Tongchuan, and Kuizhou circuits suffered successive floods and droughts; granaries were opened, rents remitted, envoys were dispatched to inspect, and where people had flowed into north of the Yangzi, local authorities were ordered to settle and support them.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods and droughts struck in succession across Jiang, Zhe, the Two Huai, Jing West, Hubei, Tongchuan, and Kuizhou; granaries were opened, rents remitted, and inspectors were sent out; refugees who had crossed north of the Yangzi were ordered settled and supported where they arrived.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月甲戌，詔四孟朝獻分用三日，如在京故事。

translations.literal: In spring of the ninth year, on the first month's jiaxu day, an edict ordered the four seasonal imperial-ancestor offerings each to use three days, following capital precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year, on the first month's jiaxu day, an edict ordered each of the four seasonal imperial-ancestor offerings to span three days, following capital practice.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命兩淮戍兵歲一更。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Two-Huai garrison troops were ordered to rotate once a year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, garrison troops in the Two Huai were ordered to rotate once a year.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷樞密都承旨王抃爲在外宮觀，因罷諸軍承受，復密院文書關錄兩省舊法，以文臣爲都承旨。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Bureau of Military Affairs Director-General Wang Bian was dismissed to an outer-circuit temple-and-abbey post; because of this, receivers in the various armies were abolished; the old practice of the Bureau's documents' being logged and forwarded to the Two Departments was restored; and a civil official was made Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Bureau of Military Affairs Director-General Wang Bian was dismissed to an outer-circuit temple-and-abbey post; army document receivers were abolished; the Bureau's old practice of logging and forwarding documents to the Two Departments was restored; and a civil official was appointed Director-General.

sentences.zh: 戊子，糴廣南米赴行在。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Guangnan rice was purchased and sent to the provisional capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, rice was purchased in Guangnan and shipped to the provisional capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔江、浙、兩淮旱傷州縣貸民稻種，計度不足者貸以樁積錢。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered drought-stricken prefectures and counties of Jiang, Zhe, and Two Huai to loan the people rice seed; where reserves were insufficient, reserve funds were to be lent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered drought-hit prefectures and counties in Jiang, Zhe, and the Two Huai to lend the people rice seed, and where reserves fell short, to lend reserve funds.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，遣使訪問二廣鹽法利害。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengxu day, envoys were dispatched to investigate the pros and cons of the salt law in the Two Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengxu day, envoys were sent to investigate the benefits and harms of the salt law in the Two Guang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，四川制置司言獲敘州賊大波浪。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, the Sichuan Pacification Commission reported that the Xu Prefecture bandit Da Bolang had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Sichuan Pacification Commission reported the capture of the Xu Prefecture bandit Da Bolang.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未朔，幸佑聖觀。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinwei first day of the month, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the month's xinwei day, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 詔振濟忠、萬、恭、涪四州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered disaster relief for the four prefectures of Zhong, Wan, Gong, and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered famine relief for Zhong, Wan, Gong, and Fu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸未，振濟鎮江。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Zhenjiang was given disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Zhenjiang received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使按視淮南、江、浙振濟。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, envoys were dispatched to inspect disaster relief in Huainan, Jiang, and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, envoys were sent to inspect famine relief in Huainan, Jiang, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷諸路寄招軍兵三年，就揀軍子弟補其闕。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, temporarily recruited soldiers on all circuits were abolished after three years; vacancies were to be filled from selected army officers' sons and brothers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, temporarily recruited soldiers on all circuits were disbanded after three years, and vacancies were to be filled from sons and brothers of serving soldiers selected for the role.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，詔自今盜發所在，親臨帥守、監司論罰，平定有勞者議賞。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiachen day, an edict ordered that henceforth wherever bandit uprisings occurred, the military commander and supervisory commissioner on the spot were to personally attend and assign punishments; those with merit in pacification were to be considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiachen day, an edict ordered that henceforth when bandits rose, the local military commander and circuit supervisor were to attend in person to assign punishments, and those who pacified disturbances with merit were to be considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸路提刑，文武臣通置一員。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict ordered one judicial-intendant post on each circuit, open to both civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, an edict ordered each circuit to maintain a single judicial-intendant post open to both civil and military appointees.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝覽陸贄《奏議》，諭講讀官曰：「今日之政，恐有如德宗之弊者，卿等條陳來上，無有所隱。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the Emperor perused Lu Zhi's 《Memorials》, and instructed the lecture officials: "Today's governance may have abuses like those of Emperor Dezong of Tang; submit detailed memorials to me and hide nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Emperor read Lu Zhi's 《Memorials》 and told the lecture officials: "Today's governance may harbor abuses like those under Tang Dezong; set out your views in memorials and conceal nothing from me.

sentences.zh: 」五月癸酉，以孫扌丙爲右千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, Sun Bing was made Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, Sun Bing was appointed Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔輔臣擇監司、郡守，必先才行。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, an edict ordered chief ministers selecting supervisory commissioners and prefects to prioritize both talent and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, an edict ordered chief ministers, in selecting circuit supervisors and prefects, to put both ability and character first.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，詔侍從、台諫各舉操修端亮、風力強明、可充監司者一二人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, an edict ordered attendant officials and remonstrating censors each to recommend one or two men of upright conduct, strong integrity, and vigorous clarity who could serve as circuit supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, an edict ordered palace attendants and remonstrating censors each to nominate one or two men of upright character and forceful integrity suitable for circuit supervision.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，蠲犒賞庫酒課二十二萬餘緡。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, more than two hundred twenty thousand strings of the wine levy owed to the Reward Treasury were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, more than 220,000 strings of the Reward Treasury wine tax were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 汀、漳二州民爲沈師蹂踐者，除其賦。

translations.literal: Taxes were remitted for the people of Ting and Zhang prefectures who had been trampled and ravaged by Shen Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were remitted for the people of Ting and Zhang prefectures who had suffered under Shen Shi's depredations.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，給臨安府貧民棺瘞錢。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, funds for coffins and burial were granted to the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, coffin and burial funds were granted to the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，謝廓然薨。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, Xie Kuoran died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xie Kuoran passed away.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 臨安府蝗，詔守臣亟加焚瘞。

translations.literal: Locusts appeared in Lin'an Prefecture; an edict ordered the prefect to burn and bury them urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Lin'an Prefecture; an edict ordered the prefect to burn and bury them without delay.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Venus was visible in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，以江西常平、義倉及樁管米四十萬石付諸司，預備振糶。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiaxu day, four hundred thousand shi of grain from Jiangxi's Ever-Normal and Righteous Granaries and stored reserves were assigned to the various offices to prepare for relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, 400,000 shi of Jiangxi Ever-Normal, Righteous Granary, and stored grain were assigned to the relevant offices for famine sales.

sentences.zh: 辛己，出南庫錢三十萬緡付浙東提舉朱熹，以備振糶。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, three hundred thousand strings of cash from the Southern Vault were issued to Zhe East Intendant Zhu Xi to prepare for relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, 300,000 strings from the Southern Vault were allotted to Zhe East Intendant Zhu Xi for famine sales.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以資政殿學士李彥穎參知政事。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Li Yanying was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Li Yanying was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔發所儲和糴米百四十萬石，補淳熙八年振濟之數，於沿江屯駐諸州樁管。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the release of one million four hundred thousand shi of stored grain-purchase rice to make up the Chunxi eighth-year relief quota, to be stored at garrison prefectures along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered 1.4 million shi of stored grain-purchase rice released to cover the Chunxi 8 relief quota, to be held at Yangzi garrison prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，詔紹興民戶去歲已納夏稅應減者三十萬緡，理爲今年之數。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, the jihai day, an edict ordered that three hundred thousand strings of summer tax from Shaoxing households that should have been reduced last year be counted toward this year's quota.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's jihai new moon, an edict applied 300,000 strings of last year's Shaoxing summer tax reductions to this year's quota.

sentences.zh: 庚子，減皇后內命婦蔭補數，立文武臣遇郊奏薦員，限致仕、遣表恩澤，視舊法捐三之一。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the number of hereditary appointments for the empress and inner appointed consorts was reduced; quotas were set for civil and military officials to present recommendations at suburban sacrifices; privileges granted on retirement and by memorial were restricted, reduced by one-third compared with the old law.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, hereditary appointments for the empress and inner consorts were cut; quotas were fixed for civil and military officials to recommend candidates at suburban rites; retirement and memorial privileges were trimmed by one-third from the old standard.

sentences.zh: 淮東、浙西蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts appeared in eastern Huai and western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck eastern Huai and western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 壬子，定諸州官捕蝗之罰。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, penalties for officials of the various prefectures who failed to capture locusts were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, penalties were set for prefectural officials who failed to capture locusts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復賞修舉荒政監司、守臣。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, rewards were again granted to circuit supervisors and prefects who had diligently carried out famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, rewards were again granted to circuit supervisors and prefects who had diligently managed famine relief.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳朔，罷諸路科買軍器物料三年。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the jisi day, requisitioned purchase of military equipment and materials on all circuits was suspended for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month's jisi new moon, requisitioned purchase of military equipment and materials was suspended on all circuits for three years.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以王淮爲左丞相，梁克家爲右丞相。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Wang Huai was made Left Chief Minister and Liang Kejia Right Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Wang Huai became Left Chief Minister and Liang Kejia Right Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以子彤爲容州觀察使，封安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Zitong was made Observer of Rongzhou and enfeoffed as Prince of Anding Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Zitong was made Observer of Rongzhou and enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大享明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, a great sacrifice was performed at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, a great Bright Hall sacrifice was held and a general amnesty declared.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以錢引十萬緡賜瀘州，備振糶。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, one hundred thousand strings of qianyin notes were granted to Luzhou to prepare for relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, 100,000 strings of qianyin notes were granted to Luzhou for famine sales.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，封伯圭爲滎陽郡王。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Bogui was enfeoffed as Prince of Xingyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Bogui was enfeoffed as Prince of Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 以旱減恭、合、渠、昌州今年酒課。

translations.literal: Because of drought, this year's wine levy was remitted for Gong, He, Qu, and Chang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought, this year's wine tax was remitted for Gong, He, Qu, and Chang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁蕃舶販易金銀，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, foreign ships were forbidden to trade in gold and silver, established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, foreign ships were forbidden to trade in gold and silver, and the ban was written into law.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌朔，遣王藺等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, the wuxu day, Wang Lin and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's wuxu new moon, Wang Lin and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丙午，罷軍器所招軍。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, recruitment of soldiers by the Armaments Directorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, recruitment of soldiers by the Armaments Directorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，塞四川沿邊支徑。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, branch paths along the Sichuan border were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, branch paths along the Sichuan border were sealed off.

sentences.zh: 戊午。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day.

sentences.zh: 金遣完顏宗回等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: Jin dispatched Wanyan Zonghui and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Jin dispatched Wanyan Zonghui and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 甲子，蠲諸路旱傷州軍淳熙七年八年逋賦，出縣官緡錢以償戶部。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, overdue taxes from drought-stricken prefectures and garrisons for the seventh and eighth years of Chunxi on all circuits were remitted, and official strings of cash were issued to reimburse the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, overdue taxes from drought-stricken prefectures and garrisons for Chunxi 7 and 8 were forgiven on all circuits, and official funds were issued to reimburse the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰朔，禁臣庶之家婦飾僭擬。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, the wuchen day, unauthorized imitation in women's adornment in the households of officials and commoners was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's wuchen new moon, women's adornment imitating court styles was forbidden in official and common households.

sentences.zh: 庚午，振夔路饑。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, famine relief was extended in Kuilu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, famine relief was extended in Kuilu circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，進奏院火。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, the Memorial Submission Office burned.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the Memorial Submission Office caught fire.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣賈選等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Jia Xuan and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Jia Xuan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大風。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, a great wind blew.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，更二廣官賣鹽法，復行客鈔，仍出緡錢四十萬以備漕計之闕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jihai day, the government salt sales law in the Two Guangs was changed and merchant salt certificates were restored; still four hundred thousand strings of cash were issued to cover shortfalls in transport-fund calculations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jihai day, the Two Guangs salt monopoly was revised and merchant salt notes restored; 400,000 strings of cash were still issued to cover transport-fund shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，金遣孛術魯正等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Jin dispatched Boluolu Zheng and others to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Jin dispatched Boluolu Zheng and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丁丑，以給事中施師點簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In spring of the tenth year, on the dingchou day of the first month, Investigating Censor Shi Shidian was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, on the first month's dingchou day, Investigating Censor Shi Shidian was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 命州縣掘蝗。

translations.literal: An order required prefectures and counties to dig up locusts.
translations.idiomatic: An order required prefectures and counties to dig up locust eggs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，李彥穎罷。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Li Yanying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Li Yanying was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命二廣提舉鹽事官互措置鹽事。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, salt intendant officials of the Two Guangs were ordered to manage salt affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, salt intendant officials of the Two Guangs were ordered to coordinate salt administration jointly.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以施師點兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Shi Shidian was concurrently appointed acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Shi Shidian was concurrently appointed acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔終身任宮觀人毋得奏子。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict ordered that persons holding lifetime posts at Taoist and Buddhist temples were not permitted to memorialize on behalf of their sons.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict barred holders of lifetime temple posts from memorializing on behalf of their sons.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔罷廣南官鬻鹽法。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, an edict abolished the government salt sales law in southern Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, an edict abolished the government salt sales monopoly in southern Guang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷江東、浙西寄招鎮江諸軍三年。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, temporary recruitment of Zhenjiang garrisons in Jiang East and western Zhe was abolished after three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, three years of temporary recruitment for Zhenjiang garrisons in Jiang East and western Zhe was ended.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，提舉德壽宮陳源有罪，竄建寧府，尋移郴州，仍籍其家貲，進納德壽宮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the guimao day, Chen Yuan, Director of Deshou Palace, was found guilty, banished to Jianning Prefecture, then transferred to Chenzhou; his household property was still confiscated and submitted to Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guimao day, Deshou Palace Director Chen Yuan was found guilty, banished to Jianning Prefecture, then transferred to Chenzhou; his household property was confiscated and turned over to Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，李燾上《續資治通鑒長編》六百八十七卷。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the wuchen day, Li Tao submitted 《Extended Compilation of the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government》 in six hundred eighty-seven juan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuchen day, Li Tao submitted the six hundred eighty-seven juan of his 《Extended Compilation of the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government》.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有司請造第七界會子。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the relevant offices requested the minting of seventh-series huizi notes.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the relevant offices requested the minting of seventh-series huizi notes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，免四川和糴三年。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, grain procurement at fair prices in Sichuan was remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, grain procurement at fair prices in Sichuan was suspended for three years.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔四川類試自今十六人取一人。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, an edict ordered that from now on the Sichuan categorized examination would select one from every sixteen candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, an edict fixed the Sichuan categorized examination at one selection for every sixteen candidates.

sentences.zh: 己丑，除詐稱災傷籍產法。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the law on falsely claiming disaster damage to register property was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the law on falsely claiming disaster damage to register property was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復銓試舊法，罷試雜文。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, the old qualification-examination rules were restored and the miscellaneous prose examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the old qualification-examination rules were restored and the miscellaneous prose examination was dropped.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，再蠲臨安府民丁身錢三年。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the bingshen day, poll-tax payments for the people of Lin'an Prefecture were again remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingshen day, poll-tax payments for Lin'an Prefecture were again forgiven for three years.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命湖南、廣西堙塞溪洞徑路。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, an order was issued for Hunan and Guangxi to block paths through streams, caves, and ravines.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Hunan and Guangxi were ordered to block paths through streams, caves, and ravines.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，增皇太子宮小學教授一員。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, one instructor was added to the crown prince's palace elementary school.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, one instructor was added to the crown prince's palace elementary school.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以潭州飛虎軍隸江陵都統司。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, the Flying Tiger Army of Tanzhou was placed under the Jiangling supreme command.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Tanzhou's Flying Tiger Army was placed under the Jiangling supreme command.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔疏襄陽水渠，以渠傍地爲屯田，尋詔民間侵耕者就給之。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered the dredging of Xiangyang irrigation channels, with land beside the channels made into garrison farms; shortly afterward an edict ordered that civilians who had encroached and cultivated the land were to be granted it on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered Xiangyang's irrigation channels dredged and adjoining land turned into garrison farms; soon afterward an edict granted encroaching cultivators title to the land they had taken.

sentences.zh: 廢舒州宿松監。

translations.literal: The Susong Salt Monopoly in Shuzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Susong Salt Monopoly in Shuzhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，監察御史陳賈請禁偽學。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuxu day, Investigating Censor Chen Jia petitioned to prohibit heterodox learning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuxu day, Investigating Censor Chen Jia asked that heterodox learning be banned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷昭州歲貢金。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the annual tribute of gold from Zhaozhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Zhaozhou's annual gold tribute was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔諸路監司、帥臣歲舉廉吏。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, an edict ordered circuit supervisors and military commissioners annually to recommend incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict ordered circuit supervisors and military commissioners to recommend incorrupt officials each year.

sentences.zh: 庚申，嚴贓吏禁。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, prohibitions on corrupt officials were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, prohibitions on corrupt officials were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，以不雨，決系囚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the yichou day, because there was no rain, detained prisoners were judged.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, because rain had not fallen, detained prisoners were reviewed and sentenced.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸明慶寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the emperor visited Mingqing Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the emperor visited Mingqing Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以夏秋旱暵，避殿減膳，令侍從、台諫、兩省、卿監、郎官、館職各陳朝政闕失，分命群臣禱雨於天地、宗廟、社稷、山川。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, because of summer and autumn drought, the emperor left the hall and reduced his meals; attendant officials, remonstrating censors, the two secretariats, ministers and directors, department directors, and academy appointees were each ordered to set forth failures in court governance; ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, and mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, summer and autumn drought led the emperor to leave the hall and cut his meals; attendants, remonstrators, secretariat officials, ministers, directors, and academy appointees were told to report governmental failings; ministers were separately dispatched to pray for rain at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, and mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 左丞相王淮等以旱乞罷，不許。

translations.literal: Left Chief Minister Wang Huai and others, because of the drought, petitioned to resign; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chief Minister Wang Huai and others asked to resign over the drought; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔除災傷州縣淳熙八年欠稅。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict remitted overdue taxes from disaster-stricken prefectures and counties for the eighth year of Chunxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict forgave overdue taxes from disaster-stricken prefectures and counties for Chunxi 8.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雨。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己丑，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the emperor resumed normal meals in the hall.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，以施師點參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the wushen day, Shi Shidian was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wushen day, Shi Shidian was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞黃洽參知政事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Huang Qia was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Huang Qia was appointed Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以史浩爲太保、魏國公致仕，庚申，以左藏南庫隸戶部。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Shi Hao was made Grand Preceptor and retired as Duke of Wei; on the gengshen day, the Left Treasury Southern Vault was placed under the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Shi Hao was made Grand Preceptor and retired as Duke of Wei; on the gengshen day, the Left Treasury Southern Vault was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，長溪、甯德縣大水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yichou day, Changxi and Ningde counties suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day, Changxi and Ningde counties suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，嚴盜販解監法。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the prohibition on illicit trade of relief-salt monopoly was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the ban on illicit trade in relief-salt monopoly was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸佑聖觀。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the emperor visited You Sheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 壬午，蠲諸州逋負內藏庫錢六十萬緡。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, six hundred thousand strings of overdue payments owed to the Inner Treasury on all circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, 600,000 strings of overdue Inner Treasury debts on all circuits were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣餘端禮等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Yu Duanli and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Yu Duanli and others were sent as envoys to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁內郡行鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, the use of iron cash within inner prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the use of iron cash within inner prefectures was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，詔兩浙義役從民便。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the yiwei day, an edict ordered voluntary labor service in the two Zhe circuits to follow local convenience.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiwei day, an edict allowed voluntary labor service in the two Zhe circuits to follow local convenience.

sentences.zh: 壬子，金遣完顏方等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Fang and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Fang and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, the renxu day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's renxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，降會子，收兩淮銅錢。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, huizi notes were devalued and copper cash was collected from the Two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, huizi notes were cut in value and copper coin was recalled from the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸龍山大閱，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, the emperor visited Dragon Hill for a grand review, then visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the emperor reviewed troops at Dragon Hill, then visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，詔卻安南獻象。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the renyin day, an edict declined Annan's gift of elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the renyin day, an edict declined Annan's gift of elephants.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣陳居仁等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Chen Juren and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Chen Juren and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，朝德壽宮，行太上皇后慶壽禮，推恩如太上皇故事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, the emperor attended Deshou Palace, performed birthday rites for the Retired Empress, and extended grace following the precedent for the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, the emperor attended Deshou Palace, performed birthday rites for the Retired Empress, and extended grace following the precedent set for the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金遣完顏婆盧火等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Boluhuo and others to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Boluhuo and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，福、漳、台、信、吉州水，京西、金、澧州、南平、荊門、興國、廣德軍、江陵、建康、鎮江、紹興、甯國府旱。

translations.literal: That year, Fu, Zhang, Tai, Xin, and Ji prefectures suffered floods; Jingxi, Jin, Li, Nanping, Jingmen, Xingguo, Guangde Army, Jiangling, Jiankang, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, and Ningguo Prefecture suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Fu, Zhang, Tai, Xin, and Ji prefectures were flooded; Jingxi, Jin, Li, Nanping, Jingmen, Xingguo, Guangde Army, Jiangling, Jiankang, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, and Ningguo Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月辛卯朔，雨土。

translations.literal: In spring of the eleventh year, on the first day of the first month, the xinmao day, soil rained.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, on the first month's xinmao new moon, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，安化蠻蒙光漸等犯宜州思立砦，廣西兵馬鈐轄沙世堅出兵討之，獲光漸。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Meng Guangjian of the Anhua barbarians and others attacked Yizhou's Sili Stockade; Sha Shijian, Military Controller of Guangxi, led troops to suppress them and captured Guangjian.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Meng Guangjian of the Anhua tribes and others attacked Yizhou's Sili Stockade; Guangxi Military Controller Sha Shijian led troops against them and captured Guangjian.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔江東、西路諸監司，義役、差役從民便。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered circuit supervisors of Jiang East and West circuits that voluntary labor service and corvée labor should follow local convenience.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered Jiang East and West circuit supervisors to let voluntary labor service and corvée follow local convenience.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雨土。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, soil rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，詔兩淮、京西、湖北萬弩手令在家閱習，每州許歲上材武者一二人，試授以官，如四川義士之制。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiashen day, an edict ordered ten-thousand crossbowmen in the Two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei circuits to drill at home; each prefecture was permitted to present one or two men of martial talent annually for trial appointment to office, following the Sichuan righteous militia system.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiashen day, an edict ordered ten-thousand crossbowmen in the Two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei to drill at home; each prefecture could present one or two men of martial talent annually for trial appointment, following the Sichuan righteous militia system.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，詔刑部、御史台每季以仲月錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinmao day, an edict ordered the Ministry of Justice and the Censorate each season, in the middle month, to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinmao day, an edict ordered the Ministry of Justice and Censorate to review prisoners each season in the middle month.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命利路三都統吳挺、郭鈞、彭杲密陳出師進取利害，以備金人。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, orders were given to the three Sichuan supreme commanders Wu Ting, Guo Jun, and Peng Gao to confidentially submit the pros and cons of fielding troops to advance, in preparation against the Jurchens.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the three Sichuan supreme commanders Wu Ting, Guo Jun, and Peng Gao were ordered to confidentially report the advantages and risks of taking the field, in preparation against the Jurchens.

sentences.zh: 復金州管內安撫司。

translations.literal: The Jinzhou intra-circuit pacification commission was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinzhou intra-circuit pacification office was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以上津、潮陽旱，蠲其稅。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, because Shangjin and Chaoyang suffered drought, their taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, drought in Shangjin and Chaoyang prompted remission of their taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷秀州御馬院莊，歸其侵地於民。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Xiuzhou Imperial Horse Stud farm was abolished, and its encroached lands were returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Xiuzhou Imperial Horse Stud estate was shut down and its seized land restored to the people.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁淮民招溫、處州戶口。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Huai-region residents were forbidden to recruit households from Wen and Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, residents of the Huai region were barred from luring settlers from Wenzhou and Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 除職田、官田八年逋租。

translations.literal: Overdue rent on salary fields and government fields for eight years was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years of unpaid rent on salary fields and government land was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔御試策有及軍民利害者，考官裒類以聞。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, an edict ordered that palace examination essays touching on the interests of soldiers and civilians be sorted by category and reported by the examiners.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, an edict directed examiners to sort and report palace examination essays addressing military and civilian welfare.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，史浩入謝，賜宴於內殿。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Shi Hao entered to give thanks and was granted a banquet in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Shi Hao came to court to give thanks and was feasted in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，以興元義勝軍移戍襄陽。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiazi day, the Xingyuan Yisheng Army was moved to garrison Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, the Xingyuan Righteous Victory Army was transferred to garrison Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賜禮部進士衛涇以下三百九十四人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, three hundred ninety-four Ministry of Rites advanced scholars from Wei Jing downward were granted passed the examination and initial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, 394 Ministry of Rites advanced scholars from Wei Jing downward received degrees and initial appointments.

sentences.zh: 癸未，重班《紹興申明刑統》。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the 《Shaoxing Clarified Penal Code》 was promulgated again.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the 《Shaoxing Clarified Penal Code》 was reissued.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子朔，蠲崇德等十六縣小民淳熙十年欠稅十四萬緡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the new moon day wuzi, one hundred forty thousand strings in taxes owed by commoners in sixteen counties including Chongde for Chunxi year ten were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuzi new moon, 140,000 strings in Chunxi 10 tax arrears owed by commoners in sixteen counties including Chongde were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命刑部、大理寺議減刺配法。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the Ministry of Justice and the Office of Review were ordered to discuss reducing the tattoo-and-exile punishment law.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the Ministry of Justice and Office of Review were instructed to draft reductions to the tattoo-and-exile statutes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，出緡錢三十萬犒給四川久戍將士。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, three hundred thousand strings in cash were disbursed to reward soldiers long garrisoned in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, 300,000 strings were distributed to reward troops long stationed in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，詔諸道總領舉偏裨可將帥者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon day wuwu, an edict ordered each circuit's general controller to recommend junior officers suited to become generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuwu new moon, an edict ordered circuit general controllers to recommend junior officers capable of command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以周必大爲樞密使。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Zhou Bida was made Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Zhou Bida was appointed Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔在內尚書、侍郎、兩省諫議大夫以上、御史中丞、學士、待制，在外守臣、監司，不限科舉年分，各舉賢良方正能直言極諫一人。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, an edict ordered Secretariat ministers and vice ministers, remonstrance grand masters and above in the two secretariats, the censor chief, academicians, and awaiting appointees at court, and prefectural officials and circuit supervisors outside, with no limit on years since the civil examination, each to recommend one worthy and upright man able to speak boldly and remonstrate to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict ordered court ministers, vice ministers, remonstrators, the chief censor, academicians, and awaiting appointees within, and prefects and circuit supervisors without, regardless of years since examination, each to recommend one upright and outspoken candidate.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔諸州歲買稻種，備農民之闕。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, an edict ordered prefectures to purchase rice seed annually to supply farmers' shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict ordered prefectures to buy rice seed each year to meet farmers' shortages.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，蠲減浙東敗闕坊場酒課。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guimao day, wine monopoly levies on distressed East Zhe workshops and fields were reduced and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guimao day, levies on distressed East Zhe wine monopolies were reduced and forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以浙西、江東水，禁諸州遏糴。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, because West Zhe and East Jiang suffered floods, all prefectures were forbidden to obstruct grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, floods in West Zhe and East Jiang prompted a ban on prefectures hoarding grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，築黎州要衝城。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, the strategic pass city in Lizhou was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Lizhou's strategic pass fort was constructed.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，遣章森使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengshen day, Zhang Sen was dispatched as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengshen day, Zhang Sen was sent to the Jin for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，詔諸路添差官自今毋創置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the dinghai day, an edict ordered that supernumerary appointees on all circuits from this time forward should not be newly created.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dinghai day, an edict barred all circuits from creating new supernumerary posts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔殿前軍子弟許權收刺一次。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, an edict permitted sons of the Palace Front Army one provisional exemption from draft enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an edict allowed sons of Palace Front Army soldiers one deferment from the conscription lottery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，再減四川酒課六十八萬餘緡。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Sichuan wine tax levies were again reduced by over six hundred eighty thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Sichuan wine taxes were again cut by more than 680,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，初命舉改官人犯贓者，舉主降二官。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the jiazi day, for the first time it was ordered that when a recommended official promoted by recommendation commits corruption, the recommender be demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiazi day, a new rule demoted recommenders two ranks when a recommendation-based appointee was convicted of corruption.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣王信等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Wang Xin and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Wang Xin and others were sent to the Jin court for the ruler's birthday felicitations.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禁諸州增收稅錢。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, all prefectures were forbidden to increase tax payments.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, prefectures were barred from raising tax levies.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣張大節等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the Jin dispatched Zhang Dajie and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the Jin sent Zhang Dajie and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 盱眙軍言得金人牒，以上京地寒，來歲正旦、生辰人使權止一年。

translations.literal: Xuyi Army reported receiving a Jin document stating that because Shangjing is cold, New Year and birthday envoys for the coming year would be temporarily suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Xuyi Army reported a Jin dispatch saying that because Shangjing is bitterly cold, New Year and birthday embassies for the coming year would be suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸以忠義立廟者，兩淮漕臣繕治之。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, an edict ordered that loyalty temples established for the faithful and righteous be maintained by Two Huai transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict ordered Two Huai transport commissioners to maintain temples erected in honor of the loyal and righteous.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，禁福建民私有兵器。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the renyin day, Fujian people were forbidden to privately own weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renyin day, private ownership of weapons by Fujian residents was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，助廣西諸州歲計十萬緡。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, one hundred thousand strings were granted to assist the annual budgets of Guangxi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, 100,000 strings were granted to support annual budgets in Guangxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，令峽州歲時存問處士郭雍。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Xiazhou was ordered to inquire annually after the reclusive scholar Guo Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xiazhou was ordered to visit the reclusive scholar Guo Yong each year.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，修湖南府城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, the Hunan prefecture city walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, the walls of Hunan Prefecture were repaired.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔戒監司、州縣毋得于常賦外追取於民。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, an edict warned circuit supervisors and prefectural and county officials not to levy beyond regular taxes from the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict warned circuit supervisors and local officials against collecting beyond regular taxes from the people.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江東、浙西諸州水，福建、廣東、吉、贛州、建昌軍、興元府、金、洋、西和州旱。

translations.literal: That year, East Jiang and West Zhe prefectures suffered floods; Fujian, Guangdong, Ji and Gan prefectures, Jianchang Army, Xingyuan Prefecture, and Jin, Yang, and Xihe prefectures suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year, East Jiang and West Zhe flooded; Fujian, Guangdong, Ji and Gan prefectures, Jianchang Army, Xingyuan Prefecture, and Jin, Yang, and Xihe suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己丑，禁交阯鹽入省地。

translations.literal: In spring of the twelfth year, on the jichou day of the first month, Jiaozhi salt was forbidden to enter Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, on the first month's jichou day, Jiaozhi salt was barred from entering the empire.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，四川制置使留正遣人誘青羌奴兒結，殺之。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Liu Zheng sent men to lure the Qing-Qiang leader Nu'erjie and kill him.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Liu Zheng sent agents to lure the Qing-Qiang chieftain Nu'erjie and kill him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜任伯雨諡曰忠敏。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Ren Boyu was posthumously honored with the title Zhongmin.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Ren Boyu was posthumously titled Zhongmin (Loyal and Keen).

sentences.zh: 庚戌，日中復有黑子。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, the sun again had a black spot.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, a black spot appeared on the sun again.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinyou day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinyou day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷諸軍額外制領將佐。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, extra unit commanders and aides in all armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, supernumerary unit commanders and aides in all armies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，置黎州防邊義勇。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, border-defense righteous militia were established in Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Lizhou border-defense righteous militia were established.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，進孫擴爲安慶軍節度使，封平陽郡王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yiyou day, Sun Kuo was promoted to Anqing Army military commissioner and enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yiyou day, Sun Kuo was promoted to Anqing Army military commissioner and enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禁習渤海樂。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, practicing Bohai music was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the practice of Bohai music was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命侍從、台諫、兩省、總領、管軍官各舉堪都、副統制者一二人。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, attendants, censors and remonstrators, both secretariats, general controllers, and army administrators were ordered each to recommend one or two men suited to serve as chief and deputy commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, attendants, censors, remonstrators, both secretariats, general controllers, and army administrators were each ordered to recommend one or two candidates for chief and deputy command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，除稅場高等累賞法。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, the cumulative reward law for high-grade tax stations was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the cumulative reward law for high-grade tax stations was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jiazi day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，班《淳熙寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, the 《Chunxi Clemency Edicts》 were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the 《Chunxi Clemency Edicts》 were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諜言故遼大石林牙假道夏人以伐金，密詔吳挺與留正議之。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, spies reported that the former Liao prince Yelü Dashi would use the Xia as a passage to attack the Jin; a secret order was sent to Wu Ting and Liu Zheng to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, intelligence reported that the former Liao prince Yelü Dashi would march through Xia territory to attack the Jin; Wu Ting and Liu Zheng were secretly ordered to discuss the matter.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the gengyin day, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengyin day, an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，福州地震。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, there was an earthquake in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Fuzhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 詔帥臣趙汝愚察守令、擇兵官、防盜賊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered military commander Zhao Ruyu to inspect prefects and magistrates, select military officers, and guard against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered military commander Zhao Ruyu to inspect local officials, choose military officers, and guard against bandits.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，立淮東強勇軍效用效士法。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, regulations were established for Huaidong Strong Brave Army effective soldiers and effect-soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, regulations were established for Huaidong Strong Brave Army effective soldiers and effect-soldiers.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，除諸軍逋欠營運錢。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, overdue transport funds owed by all armies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, overdue transport funds owed by all armies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔浙東帥臣、監司不以時上諸州臧否，奪一官。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict stripped one rank from East Zhe military commanders and circuit supervisors who did not timely submit merit-and-fault evaluations of prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict demoted East Zhe commanders and circuit supervisors one rank for failing to submit prefectural evaluations on time.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the dingyou day, Venus was visible in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingyou day, Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔二廣試攝官如銓試例，取其半。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict ordered provisional officials in the Two Guang to be tested like regular appointment examinations, with half to pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict ordered Two Guang provisional officials tested under regular appointment rules, with half to pass.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以淮西屯田鹵莽，總領、軍帥、漕臣、守臣奪官有差。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, because Huai West garrison fields were neglected, general controllers, army commanders, transport commissioners, and prefects were demoted to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, neglected Huai West garrison fields led to demotions of varying degrees for general controllers, army commanders, transport commissioners, and prefects.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，詔太上皇壽八十，令有司議慶壽禮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the guihai day, an edict stated that the Retired Emperor had reached eighty years of age and ordered officials to discuss birthday celebration rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guihai day, an edict noted the retired emperor's eightieth birthday and ordered officials to draft celebration rites.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔戶部、給舍、台諫詳官民戶役法以聞。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue, drafting reviewers, and the censorate and remonstrance office to detail the household corvée law for officials and commoners and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue, drafting reviewers, and censorate and remonstrance officials to review household corvée rules for officials and commoners and report.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，復二廣監司以下到罷酬賞法。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day, the completion-of-term reward law for Two Guang circuit supervisors and below was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day, completion-of-term rewards for Two Guang circuit supervisors and below were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔恤潮州、台州被水之家。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, an edict ordered relief for flood-affected households in Chaozhou and Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an edict ordered relief for flood-stricken households in Chaozhou and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣王信等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Wang Xin and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Wang Xin and others were sent to the Jin for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔諸路總領、軍帥、漕臣、守臣歲上屯田所收之數。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict ordered circuit general controllers, army commanders, transport commissioners, and prefects to report annually the harvests of garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict ordered circuit general controllers, army commanders, transport commissioners, and prefects to report annual garrison-field harvests.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，加上太上皇尊號曰光堯壽聖憲天體道性仁誠德經武緯文紹業興統明謨盛烈太上皇帝、太上皇后曰聖壽齊明廣慈備德太上皇后。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the xinhai day, added honorific titles to the Retired Emperor as Retired Emperor of Glorious Yao, Sage of Long Life, Constituting Heaven, Embodying the Way, Of Benevolent Nature and Sincere Virtue, Threading Military and Literary Achievement, Continuing the Founding Enterprise, Raising the Imperial Lineage, Illuminating the Grand Design, and of Flourishing Majesty, and to the Retired Empress as Retired Empress of Sacred Longevity, Equal Clarity, Broad Benevolence, and Complete Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinhai day, the court added grand honorific titles: the retired emperor became "Retired Emperor of Glorious Yao, Sage of Long Life, Constituting Heaven, Embodying the Way, Of Benevolent Nature and Sincere Virtue, Threading Military and Literary Achievement, Continuing the Founding Enterprise, Raising the Imperial Lineage, Illuminating the Grand Design, and of Flourishing Majesty," and the retired empress became "Retired Empress of Sacred Longevity, Equal Clarity, Broad Benevolence, and Complete Virtue."

sentences.zh: 甲寅，蠲施、黔州經制無額錢。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, unallocated regulatory funds in Shi and Qian prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, unallocated regulatory funds in Shi and Qian prefectures were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 命侍從各舉宗室二三人。

translations.literal: Attendants were ordered each to recommend two or three imperial clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants were ordered each to recommend two or three members of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔諸路臧否以三月終、四川、二廣以五月終來上。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, an edict ordered circuit merit-and-fault reports due by the end of the third month, and Sichuan and the Two Guang by the end of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, an edict set circuit merit-and-fault reports due by month's end in the third month, and Sichuan and the Two Guang by month's end in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，鄂州大火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the dinghai day, a great fire broke out in Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dinghai day, a great fire broke out in Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，雷。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣章森等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Zhang Sen and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Zhang Sen and others were sent to the Jin court for the ruler's birthday felicitations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Heaven and Earth were worshiped together at the Round Mound, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, a combined sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was held at the Round Mound and a general amnesty declared.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌朔，帥群臣奉上太上皇、太上皇后冊寶于德壽宮，推恩如紹興三十二年故事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the new moon day gengxu, the emperor led officials to present investiture tablets and seals to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress at Deshou Palace, extending grace following the precedent of Shaoxing year thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu new moon, the emperor led officials to present investiture tablets and seals to the retired emperor and empress at Deshou Palace, extending grace as in Shaoxing 32.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以知福州趙汝愚爲四川制置使。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Fuzhou prefect Zhao Ruyu was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Fuzhou prefect Zhao Ruyu was appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣僕散守忠等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the Jin dispatched Pusan Shouzhong and others to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the Jin sent Pusan Shouzhong and others to congratulate the coming year's New Year.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月庚辰朔，率群臣詣德壽宮行慶壽禮。

translations.literal: In spring of the thirteenth year, on the new moon day gengchen of the first month, the emperor led officials to Deshou Palace to perform birthday celebration rites.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirteenth year, on the first month's gengchen new moon, the emperor led officials to Deshou Palace for birthday celebration rites.

sentences.zh: 大赦，文武臣僚並理三年磨勘，免貧民丁身錢之半爲一百一十余萬緡，內外諸軍犒賜共一百六十萬緡。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were all granted a three-year merit review; half of the poor people's poll tax was remitted, totaling over one million one hundred thousand strings; rewards to all armies inside and outside totaled one million six hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared; civil and military officials received three-year merit reviews; half the poll tax for the poor was forgiven, totaling over 1.1 million strings; rewards to all armies inside and outside totaled 1.6 million strings.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以史浩爲太傅，陳俊卿爲少師，嗣濮王士歆爲少保。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Shi Hao was made Grand Preceptor, Chen Junqing Junior Preceptor, and Heir Prince of Pu Shixin Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Shi Hao was made Grand Preceptor, Chen Junqing Junior Preceptor, and Heir Prince of Pu Shixin Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以昭慶軍節度使士峴爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Zhaoging Army military commissioner Shixian was made Grand Master with honor equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zhaoging Army military commissioner Shixian was made Grand Master with honors equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，詔強盜兩次以上，雖爲從，論死。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiayin day, an edict ordered that robbers convicted two or more times, even as accomplices, be sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiayin day, an edict ruled that repeat robbers, even as accomplices, would be sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔舉歸正、添差、任滿人才藝堪從軍者。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered recommendations of Guizheng returnees, supernumerary appointees, and term-completed officials with martial talent suited for military service.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict called for recommendations of Guizheng returnees, supernumerary appointees, and term-completed officials with martial talent fit for military service.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，詔職事官改官，許在歲額八十員之外。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the dingyou day, an edict permitted promotions of functional officials outside the annual quota of eighty positions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingyou day, an edict allowed functional officials' promotions beyond the annual quota of eighty positions.

sentences.zh: 合提舉廣南東、西鹽事司爲一。

translations.literal: The offices for supervising salt affairs in East and West Guangnan were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: The East and West Guangnan salt-supervision offices were merged into one.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，詔吳挺結約夏人。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the xinhai day, an edict ordered Wu Ting to ally with the Xia people.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinhai day, an edict ordered Wu Ting to ally with the Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，再蠲四川和糴軍糧三年。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, fair-price grain procurement for military grain in Sichuan was again remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Sichuan fair-price grain procurement for military grain was again suspended for three years.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Prospect Gathering Garden.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the guiwei day, there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiwei day, a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔非泛補官及七色補官人、非曾任在朝侍從者，品秩雖高，毋得免役。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered that those not specially appointed, nor seven-category appointees, nor former court attendants, however high their rank, may not be exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict ruled that officials not specially appointed, not seven-category appointees, and not former court attendants could not claim corvée exemption, however high their rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜沖晦處士郭雍號曰頤正先生，仍遣官就問雍所欲言，備錄來上。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the reclusive scholar Guo Yong was granted the title Master Yizheng, and an official was dispatched to ask what Guo wished to say, record it fully, and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, reclusive scholar Guo Yong was granted the title Master Yizheng, and an official was sent to ask his views, record them fully, and report upward.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，詔內外諸軍主帥各舉堪統制者二三人。
