translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the renchen day, an edict ordered army commanders inside and outside each to recommend two or three men suited to serve as commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renchen day, an edict ordered army commanders inside and outside each to recommend two or three candidates for command.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，諡胡銓曰忠簡。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Hu Quan was posthumously honored with the title Zhongjian.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Hu Quan was posthumously titled Zhongjian (Loyal and Simple).

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午朔，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the new moon day bingwu, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the bingwu new moon, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以敷文閣學士留正簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Fawen Hall academician Liu Zheng was appointed to sign documents for the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Fawen Hall academician Liu Zheng was appointed to sign Military Affairs documents.

sentences.zh: 己酉，施師點乞免兼同知樞密院事，許之。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Shi Shidian requested relief from concurrently serving as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Shi Shidian asked to be relieved of his concurrent post as Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己未，五星皆伏。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, all five planets were concealed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, all five planets were invisible.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥朔，日、月、五星聚於軫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day yihai, the Sun, Moon, and five planets gathered in the Mansion Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon yihai day, the sun, moon, and five planets converged in the Zhen mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以故相曾懷鬻奏補恩，追落觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, because the former chief minister Zeng Huai sold memorials to obtain favors, his title of Grand Academician of the Guanwen Hall was posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, former chief minister Zeng Huai was posthumously stripped of Grand Academician of Guanwen Hall for selling memorials in exchange for favors.

sentences.zh: 壬午，新築江陵城成。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the newly built Jiangling city wall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the newly built Jingzhou walls were completed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，詔偽造會子凡經行用，並處死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yisi, an edict ordered that all counterfeit huizi notes that had circulated were to be punished by death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, an edict prescribed death for anyone who had circulated counterfeit huizi notes.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣李獻等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: That month, Li Xian and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Xian and others were sent to the Jin for New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，福州火。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day jiaxu, a fire broke out in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon jiaxu day, Fuzhou was stricken by fire.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金遣完顏老等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Jin sent Wanyan Lao and others to congratulate the Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the Jin sent Wanyan Lao and others for the Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月癸亥，出四川樁積米貸濟金、洋州及關外四州饑民。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourteenth year, the first month, on the day guihai, stored grain from Sichuan was issued as loans to relieve the starving people of Jinzhou, Yangzhou, and the four prefectures beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourteenth year, on the first month's guihai day, Sichuan reserve grain was loaned out to famine victims in Jin, Yang, and four prefectures outside the passes.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，以周必大爲右丞相。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dinghai, Zhou Bida was made Right Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dinghai day, Zhou Bida was made right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以施師點知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Shi Shidian was made director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Shi Shidian was appointed director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiazi, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiazi day, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，置籍考諸路上供殿最，以爲賞罰。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jimao, registers were established to assess the superior and inferior tribute from the various circuits for use in rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jimao day, registers were set up to grade circuit tribute performance for rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜禮部進士王容以下四百三十五人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Ministry of Rites jinshi Wang Rong and 434 others below him were granted pass degrees and preliminary degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, 435 Ministry of Rites jinshi from Wang Rong downward received pass and preliminary degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，成都火。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yisi, a fire broke out in Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yisi day, Chengdu caught fire.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣官措置汀州經界。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, officials were dispatched to arrange land-boundary measures in Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, officials were sent to organize land registration in Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，以久旱，班畫龍祈雨法。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, because of prolonged drought, the dragon-painted rain-prayer method was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuyin day, prolonged drought prompted promulgation of the painted-dragon rain ritual.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸太一宮、明慶寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the emperor visited the Grand Unity Palace and Mingqing Monastery to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the emperor prayed for rain at the Grand Unity Palace and Mingqing Monastery.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，梁克家薨。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Liang Kejia died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Liang Kejia died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，臨安府火。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a fire broke out in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Lin'an Prefecture caught fire.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Venus was visible in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，王淮等以旱求罷，不許。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Wang Huai and others requested dismissal on account of drought; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Wang Huai and others asked to resign over the drought and were refused.

sentences.zh: 詔衡州葺炎帝陵廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the repair of the tomb and temple of Emperor Yan in Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered repairs to the Yan Emperor tomb-temple in Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，減兩浙路囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, sentences for Two-Zhejiang Circuit prisoners were reduced by one degree, and those subject to the rod or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Two-Zhejiang prisoners had sentences reduced one grade; those liable to beating or less were freed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，罷戶部上供殿最。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinchou, the Household Ministry's assessment of superior and inferior tribute was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinchou day, Household Ministry tribute grading was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔群臣陳時政闕失及當今急務。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered the officials to state current policy failures and urgent matters of the day.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, officials were ordered to report policy failures and urgent matters.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以旱，罷汀州經界。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, because of drought, Tingzhou land-boundary measures were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Ting land registration was suspended on account of drought.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔監司條上州縣弊事、民間疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict ordered circuit supervisors to list in detail the abuses of prefectures and counties and the hardships of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, circuit commissioners were ordered to report local abuses and popular distress.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，避殿減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the emperor withdrew from the main hall, reduced his meals, and ceased music.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the emperor left the main hall, cut rations, and halted music.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命檢正都司看詳群臣封事，有可行者以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Verification Office of the Central Secretariat was ordered to review memorials sealed by the officials; feasible items were to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Verification Office was to review sealed memorials and report what was feasible.

sentences.zh: 詔省部、漕臣催理已蠲逋欠者，令台諫覺察。

translations.literal: An edict ordered provincial ministries and transport commissioners that those who pressed collection of overdue debts already remitted were to be investigated by remonstrance and censor officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict warned ministries and transport commissioners that censors would investigate anyone collecting debts already remitted.

sentences.zh: 權減秀州經、總制糴本錢半年。

translations.literal: Provisionally, Xiuzhou's grain-purchase capital for the circuit and general-control funds was reduced for half a year.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuzhou grain-purchase capital for circuit and general-control accounts was temporarily halved for six months.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命臨安府捕蝗，募民輸米振濟。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to catch locusts and recruit the people to submit grain for famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Lin'an was ordered to exterminate locusts and accept grain donations for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 除紹興新科下戶今年和市布帛二萬八千匹。

translations.literal: Exempted the 28,000 bolts of cloth and silk for state procurement this year from the new-category lower households of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing's newly classified lower households were exempted from this year's 28,000-bolt state cloth levy.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，江西、湖南饑，給度僧牒，鬻以糴米備振糶。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, because Jiangxi and Hunan were famine-stricken, ordination certificates were issued and sold to procure grain for relief distribution.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Jiangxi and Hunan famine prompted sale of ordination certificates to buy grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，雨。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 命給、舍看詳監司所條弊事。

translations.literal: Orders were given for the drafting and reviewing officials to examine the abuses listed by circuit supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting and reviewing officials were ordered to examine abuses reported by circuit supervisors.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，賜度牒一百道、米四萬五千石，備振紹興府饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinwei, one hundred ordination certificates and 45,000 shi of grain were granted to prepare relief for famine in Shaoxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, 100 ordination certificates and 45,000 shi of grain were issued for Shaoxing famine relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the emperor returned to the hall and resumed full meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the emperor returned to court and full rations.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以留正參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Liu Zheng was made Vice Grand Councilor and concurrently deputy director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Liu Zheng was appointed vice grand councilor and deputy director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復夔路酬賞法。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the reward law of Kuizhou Circuit was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the Qian reward statute was restored.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，太上皇不豫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, the Retired Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guimao day, the retired emperor took ill.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詣德壽宮問疾。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the emperor went to Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣萬鐘等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wan Zhong and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Wan Zhong and others were sent to the Jin for New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 己未，詣德壽宮問疾。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the emperor went to Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the emperor again visited Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷增收木渠民田租。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the additional rent levied on civilian fields through the wooden canal was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, supplemental rent on canal-irrigated farmland was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，除官軍私負。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, private debts of the official armies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, soldiers' private debts were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，以太上皇不豫，赦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinwei, an amnesty was issued because the Retired Emperor was ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinwei day, an amnesty was declared because the retired emperor was ill.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詣德壽宮問疾。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the emperor went to Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，分遣群臣禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the officials were dispatched in groups to pray at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, officials were sent to pray at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以太上皇未御常膳，自來日不視朝，宰執奏事內殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, because the Retired Emperor had not taken his regular meals, from the next day the emperor would not hold court; the chief ministers would report business in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, because the retired emperor could not take regular meals, court audiences were suspended from the next day and the chief ministers would report in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詣德壽宮侍疾，太上皇崩于德壽殿，遺誥太上皇后改稱皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the emperor went to Deshou Palace to attend the illness; the Retired Emperor died in the Deshou Hall. The testamentary edict changed the title of the Retired Empress to Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the emperor attended the retired emperor at Deshou Palace; the retired emperor died in Deshou Hall. His testamentary edict renamed the retired empress as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后旨，以奉國軍承宣使甘昪主管太上皇喪事。

translations.literal: In accordance with the Empress Dowager's order, Gan Bian, grand master-in-attendance of the Fengguo Army, was put in charge of the Retired Emperor's funeral affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Per the empress dowager's order, Fengguo Army grand master Gan Bian was placed in charge of the retired emperor's funeral.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以韋璞等爲金告哀使。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wei Pu and others were appointed envoys to announce the mourning to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Wei Pu and others were appointed mourning envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以滎陽郡王伯圭爲欑宮總護使。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Prince of Xingyang, Bo Gui, was made general supervisor of the coffining hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince of Xingyang Bo Gui was made general supervisor of the coffining hall.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士洪邁言大行皇帝廟號當稱「祖」，詔有司集議以聞。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Hong Mai said the temple title of the late emperor should be "Zu"; an edict ordered the relevant offices to assemble opinions and report.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Hong Mai argued the late emperor's temple name should use Zu; the relevant offices were ordered to debate and report.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔尊皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict honored the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict extended honors to the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔曰：「大行太上皇帝奄棄至養，朕當衰服三年，群臣自遵易月之令，可令有司討論儀制以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict said: "The late Retired Emperor has suddenly departed this best of care; I ought to wear mourning garments for three years. The officials themselves should follow the order of the shortened month mourning. Let the relevant offices discuss the ritual regulations and report."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict read: "The late retired emperor has suddenly left this world of care; I shall wear full mourning for three years while officials observe the abbreviated mourning rule. The relevant offices are to draft ritual protocol and report."

sentences.zh: 」甲申，用禮官顏師魯等言，大行太上皇帝上繼徽宗正統，廟號稱「宗」。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, following the advice of ritual officials Yan Shilu and others, the late Retired Emperor, succeeding to the legitimate line of Emperor Huizong, was given the temple title "Zong."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, following ritual officials Yan Shilu and others, the late retired emperor was given temple name Zong as successor to Huizong's legitimate line.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，百官五上表請帝還內聽政。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the hundred officials five times submitted memorials requesting that the emperor return inside to hold audience and govern.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the full bureaucracy five times petitioned the emperor to resume governance within the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔俟過小祥，勉從所請。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict said that after passing the xiaoxiang mourning period, he would reluctantly accede to their request.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an edict deferred to the petitions until after the xiaoxiang period.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝衰絰御素輦還內。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the emperor, in hemp mourning garments, rode the plain carriage and returned inside.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the emperor returned inside in hemp mourning aboard the plain palanquin.

sentences.zh: 以顏師魯等充金國遣留國信使。

translations.literal: Yan Shilu and others were appointed envoys of credence retained in Jin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shilu and others were appointed retained credence envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，金遣田彥皋等來賀會慶節，詔免入見，卻其書幣。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Jin sent Tian Yangao and others to congratulate the Celebration Festival; an edict exempted them from audience and returned their documents and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Jin sent Tian Yangao and others for the Celebration Festival; they were exempted from audience and their gifts were declined.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詣德壽宮，自是七日皆如之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the emperor went to Deshou Palace; from then on he did so every seven days.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace; thereafter he did so every seven days.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌朔，詣德壽宮，自是朔望皆如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day wuxu, the emperor went to Deshou Palace; from then on he did so on each new and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon wuxu day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace; thereafter he did so at every new and full moon.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大行太上皇帝大祥，自是帝以白布巾袍御延和殿。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the daxiang mourning for the late Retired Emperor arrived; from then the emperor wore white cloth cap and robe when holding court in the Yanhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the late retired emperor reached daxiang mourning; thereafter the emperor held court at Yanhe Hall in white cloth cap and robe.

sentences.zh: 詣德壽宮，衰絰而杖如初。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Deshou Palace, wearing hemp mourning garments and leaning on a staff as at first.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Deshou Palace again in full hemp mourning with staff as before.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太子惇參決庶務。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Crown Prince Dun to participate in deciding ordinary affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict empowered Crown Prince Dun to participate in routine governance.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇太子三辭參決庶務，不許。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Crown Prince thrice declined to participate in deciding ordinary affairs; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the crown prince thrice declined routine participation in governance and was refused.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詣德壽宮禫祭，百官釋服。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the emperor went to Deshou Palace for the tuan sacrifice; the hundred officials were released from mourning garments.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the emperor performed tu rites at Deshou Palace; officials were released from mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，群臣三上表請御殿聽政，詔俟過祔廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the officials three times submitted memorials requesting that the emperor hold audience in the hall and govern; an edict said to wait until after enshrinement in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, officials thrice petitioned the emperor to resume hall audiences; an edict deferred until after enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 戊申。

translations.literal: On the day wushen.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day.

sentences.zh: 遣胡晉臣等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Hu Jinchen and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Jinchen and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，冬至，詣德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the winter solstice, the emperor went to Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice, the xinhai day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，西南方有赤氣隨日入。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, in the southwest there was a crimson vapor following the setting sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, crimson vapor in the southwest followed the sunset.

sentences.zh: 乙卯。

translations.literal: On the day yimao.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day.

sentences.zh: 雷。

translations.literal: Thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔皇太子參決庶務於議事堂，在內寺監、在外守臣以下，與宰執同除授訖乃奏。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, an edict ordered the Crown Prince to participate in deciding ordinary affairs in the Deliberation Hall; for inner palace bureaus and outer prefects and below, appointments were to be made jointly with the chief ministers and only then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the crown prince was ordered to deliberate routine affairs in the Deliberation Hall; inner bureaus and local officials were to be appointed jointly with the chief ministers before memorializing.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔三日一朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, an edict ordered audiences at Deshou Palace every three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, an edict mandated visits to Deshou Palace every three days.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，大理寺獄空。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengwu, the prison of the Court of Judicial Review was empty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengwu day, the Court of Judicial Review's prison was empty.

sentences.zh: 壬午，東北方有赤氣隨日出。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, in the northeast there was a crimson vapor following the rising sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, crimson vapor in the northeast followed the sunrise.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金遣完顏崇安等來賀明年正旦，見於垂拱殿之東楹素幄，詔禮物毋入殿，付之有司。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Jin sent Wanyan Chong'an and others to congratulate the coming New Year; they were received in the plain canopy at the east pillar of the Chui Gong Hall; an edict ordered that gifts not enter the hall and be handed to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the Jin sent Wanyan Chong'an and others for the next New Year; they were received in a plain canopy at Chui Gong Hall's east bay, and gifts were barred from the hall and turned over to officials.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙、江西、淮西、福建旱，振之。

translations.literal: That year, Two-Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huaixi, and Fujian suffered drought; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: That year, drought in Two-Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huaixi, and Fujian brought famine relief.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丁酉朔，詣德壽宮几筵行禮。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifteenth year, the first month, on the first day dingyou, the emperor went to Deshou Palace to perform rites before the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifteenth year, on the first month's new moon dingyou day, the emperor performed rites at Deshou Palace before the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，皇太子初決庶務於議事堂。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Crown Prince for the first time decided ordinary affairs in the Deliberation Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the crown prince first deliberated routine affairs in the Deliberation Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復置左、右補闕、拾遺。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Left and Right Omission Officers and Remonstrance Officers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, left and right omission and remonstrance officers were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔免諸州軍會慶節進奉二年。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict remitted the Celebration Festival tribute from all prefectures and armies for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Celebration Festival tribute from all prefectures and armies was waived for two years.

sentences.zh: 詔自今御內殿，令皇太子侍立。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from now on when holding court in the inner hall, the Crown Prince was to stand in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required the crown prince to stand in attendance whenever the emperor held court in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，施師點罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Shi Shidian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Shi Shidian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以黃洽知樞密院事，吏部尚書蕭燧參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Huang Qia was made director of Military Affairs; Personnel Minister Xiao Sui was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Huang Qia was appointed director of Military Affairs and Personnel Minister Xiao Sui vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，金遣蒲察克忠等來弔祭，行禮于德壽殿，次見帝於東楹之素幄。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dinghai, the Jin sent Pucha Kezhong and others to offer condolences; they performed the rites in Deshou Hall, then were received by the emperor in the plain canopy at the east pillar.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dinghai day, the Jin sent Pucha Kezhong and others to mourn; rites were performed at Deshou Hall, then the emperor received them in the plain east-bay canopy.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣京鏜等使金報謝。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Jing Tang and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Jing Tang and others were sent to the Jin with thanks.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，王淮等上大行太上皇諡曰聖神武文憲孝皇帝，廟號高宗。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Wang Huai and others submitted the posthumous title Sacred, Divine, Martial, Literary, Principled, and Filial Emperor for the late Retired Emperor, with temple title Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengzi day, Wang Huai and others proposed posthumous title Sacred Divine Martial Literary Principled Filial Emperor and temple name Gaozong for the late retired emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上高宗諡冊寶于德壽殿，又上懿節皇后改諡憲節冊寶於別廟本室。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the posthumous edict, seal, and seal-stone for Gaozong were presented in Deshou Hall; the changed posthumous edict, seal, and seal-stone for Empress Yijie, renamed Xianjie, were also presented in the separate temple's main chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Gaozong's posthumous registers and seals were presented at Deshou Hall; Empress Yijie, renamed Xianjie, received hers at the separate temple shrine.

sentences.zh: 丁未，右丞相周必大攝太傅，持節導梓宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Right Chief Minister Zhou Bida acted as Grand Tutor, bearing the staff to escort the bier.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, right chief minister Zhou Bida served as acting grand tutor, bearing credentials to escort the bier.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，用洪邁議，以呂頤浩、趙鼎、韓世忠、張俊配饗高宗廟庭，吏部侍郎章森乞用張浚、岳飛，秘書少監楊萬里乞用浚，皆不報。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, following Hong Mai's proposal, Lü Yihao, Zhao Ding, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun the general were enshrined as associates in Gaozong's temple court; Personnel Vice Minister Zhang Sen requested Zhang Jun the statesman and Yue Fei; Secretariat Vice Director Yang Wanli requested Zhang Jun the statesman—all were not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, per Hong Mai's proposal, Lü Yihao, Zhao Ding, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun the general were enshrined at Gaozong's temple; Personnel Vice Minister Zhang Sen argued for Zhang Jun the statesman and Yue Fei, and Secretariat Vice Director Yang Wanli for Zhang Jun the statesman—all went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，權欑高宗於永思陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Gaozong was provisionally coffined at Yongsi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Gaozong was provisionally entombed at Yongsi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，帝親行奉迎虞主之禮，自是七虞、八虞、九虞、卒哭、奉辭皆如之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day renshen, the emperor personally performed the rites of escorting and receiving the spirit tablet; thereafter the seventh, eighth, and ninth yu rites, ziku, and final farewell rites were all performed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renshen day, the emperor personally performed escort and reception rites for the spirit tablet; the seventh through ninth yu rites, ziku, and final farewell followed in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔洪邁、楊萬里並予郡。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict granted Hong Mai and Yang Wanli both prefectural posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Hong Mai and Yang Wanli were both granted prefectural appointments.

sentences.zh: 甲申，用禮官尤袤請，詔群臣再集議配享臣僚。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, following ritual official You Mao's request, an edict ordered the officials again to assemble for deliberation on the associate ministers for enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, per ritual official You Mao's request, officials were ordered to reconvene on associate enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祔高宗神主於太廟，詔曰：「朕比下令欲衰絰三年，群臣屢請御殿易服，故以布素視事內殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Gaozong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict said: "I recently issued orders wishing to wear the coarsest mourning sackcloth for three years; officials repeatedly asked me to hold court and change dress, so I have been conducting affairs in plain white within the inner halls.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Gaozong's spirit tablet was installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict read: "I had ordered three years in the coarsest mourning hemp, but officials kept asking me to hold court and change dress, so I have been governing in plain white within the inner halls.

sentences.zh: 雖詔俟過祔廟，勉從所請，然稽諸典禮，心實未安，行之終制，乃爲近古。

translations.literal: Although the edict waited until after enshrinement in the temple to accede to their request, when I checked against the rites my heart truly was not at ease; carrying through to the end of mourning is what comes nearest to antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Though I agreed to wait until after the temple enshrinement, my heart is not at ease when I weigh the rites; to see mourning through to the end is what comes nearest to antiquity.

sentences.zh: 宜體至意，勿復有請。

translations.literal: You should respect my deepest intent and do not petition again."
translations.idiomatic: Honor my deepest intent, and do not petition again."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，詔減臨安、紹興府囚罪一等，釋杖以下，民緣欑宮役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict reduced by one grade the sentences of prisoners in Lin'an and Shaoxing prefectures, released those subject to the cane or below, and remitted taxes for people serving corvée on account of the coffining hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Lin'an and Shaoxing prisoners had sentences reduced one grade; those liable to beating or less were freed, and corvée taxes were waived for people serving on the coffining hall.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，用御史冷世光言，罷再議配享。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, following Censor Leng Shiguang's advice, reconvening to discuss associate enshrinement was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, per Censor Leng Shiguang's memorial, further deliberation on associate enshrinement was halted.

sentences.zh: 皇太后有旨，車駕一月四詣德壽宮，如舊禮。

translations.literal: The empress dowager issued an order that the imperial carriage should visit Deshou Palace four times a month, as in the old rite.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered that the emperor visit Deshou Palace four times a month, as before.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，王淮罷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, Wang Huai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jihai day, Wang Huai was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝既用薛叔似言罷王淮，詔諭叔似等曰：「卿等官以拾遺、補闕爲名，不任糾劾。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, since the emperor had dismissed Wang Huai following Xue Shusi's advice, an edict instructed Shusi and the others: "Your offices bear the names Remonstrance and Omission; you are not charged with impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, having dismissed Wang Huai on Xue Shusi's advice, the emperor addressed Shusi and his colleagues: "Your posts are named Remonstrance and Omission; you are not charged with impeachment.

sentences.zh: 今所奏乃類彈擊，甚非設官命名之意，宜思自警。

translations.literal: What you have now submitted resembles partisan attacks; this greatly departs from the intent of establishing these offices. You should reflect and warn yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: What you have submitted now reads like partisan attacks—far from the purpose of these offices. Take this as a warning."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，詔修《高宗實錄》。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, an edict ordered compilation of the 《Veritable Records of Gaozong》.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict ordered compilation of the 《Veritable Records of Gaozong》.

sentences.zh: 己未，祁門縣大水。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, great flood at Qimen County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Qimen County suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，始御後殿。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the emperor began to hold court in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the emperor began holding court in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 詔歲出錢五萬六千餘緡，減廣東十二州折納米價錢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered annual disbursement of more than fifty-six thousand strings of cash to reduce the grain commutation price for the twelve prefectures of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allotted more than 56,000 strings of cash each year to lower the commuted-rice price in Guangdong's twelve prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷敕令所。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Edict Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Edict Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以伯圭爲少傅，帶御器械夏執中爲奉國軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Bo Gui was made Junior Preceptor, and Xia Zhizhong, Bearer of Imperial Armaments, was made military commissioner of the Fengguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Bo Gui was made junior preceptor, and Bearer of Imperial Armaments Xia Zhizhong was appointed military commissioner of the Fengguo Army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以新江西提點刑獄朱熹爲兵部郎官，熹以疾未就職。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the newly appointed Jiangxi intendant of criminal justice Zhu Xi was made vice minister of the Ministry of War; Xi, owing to illness, had not yet taken office.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, newly appointed Jiangxi intendant of criminal justice Zhu Xi was made vice minister of war; Xi, ill, had not yet reported.

sentences.zh: 侍郎林栗劾熹慢命，熹乞奉祠。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Lin Li impeached Xi for disrespecting the appointment; Xi petitioned for a sinecure temple post.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Lin Li impeached Xi for tardiness in taking office; Xi asked to hold a sinecure temple post instead.

sentences.zh: 太常博士葉適論栗襲王淮、鄭丙、陳賈之說，爲「道學」之目，妄廢正人。

translations.literal: Academician Expositor of the Grand Master of Ceremonies Ye Shi argued that Li had adopted the views of Wang Huai, Zheng Bing, and Chen Jia, treating men under the label of "Way Learning" and wantonly dismissing upright officials.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Ceremonies academician expositor Ye Shi contended that Li had taken up the arguments of Wang Huai, Zheng Bing, and Chen Jia, branding men under the label "Way Learning" and wantonly removing upright officials.

sentences.zh: 詔熹仍赴江西，熹力辭不赴。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xi still to proceed to Jiangxi; Xi strenuously declined and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: An edict still ordered Xi to take up the Jiangxi post; Xi firmly declined and did not go.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，熒惑犯太微。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Mars trespassed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Mars trespassed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，上高宗廟樂曰《大勳》，舞曰《大德》。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuxu, the music for Gaozong's temple was named 《Great Meritorious Achievement》 and the dance 《Great Virtue》.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuxu day, Gaozong's temple music was titled 《Great Meritorious Achievement》 and the dance 《Great Virtue》.

sentences.zh: 己未，出兵部侍郎林栗。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Vice Minister of War Lin Li was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Vice Minister of War Lin Li was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，恩平郡王璩薨，追封信王。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Prince of Enping, Yu, died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Prince of Enping Zhao Yu died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, jiazi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's jiazi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子夜，南方有赤黃氣覆大內。

translations.literal: On the night of the gengzi day in the ninth month, red and yellow vapors in the south covered the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the ninth month's gengzi day, red and yellow vapors in the south shrouded the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大饗明堂，以太祖、太宗配，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, a great sacrifice was performed at the Bright Hall with Taizu and Taizong as associates, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, a great Bright Hall sacrifice was held with Taizu and Taizong as associates, followed by a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，更試補醫官法。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the method for trial appointment of medical officials was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the trial appointment method for medical officials was revised.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣鄭僑等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Zheng Qiao and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Zheng Qiao and others were sent to Jin to congratulate the new year.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上皇太后宮名慈福。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the empress dowager's palace was named Cifu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the empress dowager's palace was named Cifu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，金遣王克溫等來賀會慶節，見於垂拱殿東楹。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day guiwei, Jin dispatched Wang Kewen and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival; they were received at the east column of Chui Gong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guiwei day, Jin sent Wang Kewen and others for the Joint Celebration Festival; they were received at the east column of Chui Gong Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，會慶節，詔北使、百官詣東上閣門拜表起居，免入賀。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Joint Celebration Festival; an edict ordered northern envoys and the hundred officials to present congratulations at the eastern upper gate and exempted them from entering to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Joint Celebration Festival; northern envoys and officials were ordered to present congratulations at the eastern upper gate and were exempted from entering the palace to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 己丑，再罷諸州科買軍器物料三年。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, requisitioned purchase of military equipment and materials was again suspended for three years in all prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, requisitioned purchase of military equipment and materials was again suspended in all prefectures for three years.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，建煥章閣，藏高宗御集。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengzi, Huanzhang Pavilion was built to store Gaozong's collected imperial writings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, Huanzhang Pavilion was built to house Gaozong's collected writings.

sentences.zh: 遣何澹賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: He Tan was dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: He Tan was dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔百官輪對，毋過三奏。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, an edict ordered officials in rotation to address the throne to submit no more than three memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, an edict limited rotating palace memorialists to no more than three submissions.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，追復龔茂良資政殿學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingyin, Gong Maoliang's title as Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance was posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, Gong Maoliang's title as Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命朱熹主管西太一宮兼崇政殿說書，辭不至。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Zhu Xi was ordered to direct the Western Grand Unity Palace and concurrently serve as lecturer at Chongzheng Hall; he declined and did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Zhu Xi was ordered to direct the Western Grand Unity Palace and lecture at Chongzheng Hall; he declined and did not report.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金遣田彥皋等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin dispatched Tian Yangao and others to congratulate the new year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Jin sent Tian Yangao and others to congratulate the coming new year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江西、湖北、兩淮、建寧府、徽州水。

translations.literal: That year, Jiangxi, Hubei, the Two Huai, Jianning Prefecture, and Huizhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year, floods struck Jiangxi, Hubei, the Two Huai, Jianning Prefecture, and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月癸巳，金主雍殂，孫璟立。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the sixteenth year, on the day guisi, Jin Emperor Yong died; his grandson Jing succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixteenth year, on the first month's guisi day, Jin Emperor Yong died; his grandson Jing succeeded.

sentences.zh: 甲午，封孫抦爲嘉國公。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Zhao Bing was enfeoffed as Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Zhao Bing was enfeoffed as Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 丙申，黃洽罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Huang Qia was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Huang Qia was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以周必大爲左丞相，留正爲右丞相，蕭燧兼權知樞密院事，禮部尚書王藺參知政事，刑部尚書葛邲同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Zhou Bida was made Left Chief Minister, Liu Zheng Right Chief Minister, Xiao Sui concurrently acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Minister of Rites Wang Lin Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Minister of Justice Ge Bi associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Zhou Bida was made left chief minister, Liu Zheng right chief minister, Xiao Sui concurrently acting director of military affairs, Minister of Rites Wang Lin vice director of state affairs, and Minister of Justice Ge Bi associate director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蕭燧罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Xiao Sui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Xiao Sui was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，皇太后移御慈福宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the empress dowager moved her residence to Cifu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the empress dowager moved to Cifu Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以昭慶軍承宣使郭師禹爲保大軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Palace Communication Commissioner Guo Shiyu was made military commissioner of the Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Palace Communication Commissioner Guo Shiyu was appointed military commissioner of the Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，罷淮西屯田。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Huai West military colony was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Huai West military colony was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝始諭二府，以旬日當內禪，命周必大留身呈詔草。

translations.literal: That same day, the emperor first informed the Two Palaces that within ten days he would abdicate in the inner palace and ordered Zhou Bida to remain after audience and present the draft edict.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the emperor first told the Two Palaces he would abdicate within ten days and ordered Zhou Bida to remain after audience and present the draft edict.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷拘催錢所。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the office for detaining and pressing debt payments was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the office for detaining and pressing debt payments was abolished.

sentences.zh: 復二廣官般官賣鹽法。

translations.literal: The Two Guang government convoy salt sales law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Guang government convoy salt sales law was restored.

sentences.zh: 己未，更德壽宮爲重華宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Deshou Palace was renamed Chonghua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Deshou Palace was renamed Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 諡李綱曰忠定。

translations.literal: Li Gang was posthumously titled Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was posthumously titled Loyal and Settled.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's xinyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，下詔傳位皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict was issued transferring the throne to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict transferred the throne to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: That same day, the crown prince ascended the throne as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the crown prince ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝素服駕之重華宮。

translations.literal: The emperor, in plain dress, drove to Chonghua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, in plain dress, drove to Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上尊號曰至尊壽皇聖帝，皇后曰壽成皇后。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the honorific title Supreme August Longevity Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Empress Shoucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the honorific Supreme August Longevity Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Empress Shoucheng.

sentences.zh: 紹熙五年五月壬戌，壽皇聖帝不豫。

translations.literal: In Shaoxi year five, the fifth month, on the day renxu, the Longevity Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi year five, on the fifth month's renxu day, the Longevity Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，崩于重華殿，年六十有八。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuxu, he died in Chonghua Hall at the age of sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuxu day, he died in Chonghua Hall at age sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 十有丙辰，諡曰哲文神武成孝皇帝，廟號孝宗。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the day bingchen, the posthumous title Philosophical, Literary, Martial, Achieving, and Filial Emperor was granted, with temple name Xiaozong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the bingchen day, the posthumous title Philosophical Literary Martial Achieving Filial Emperor was granted, with temple name Xiaozong.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，權欑於永阜陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yimao, he was provisionally entombed at Yongfu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, he was provisionally entombed at Yongfu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 慶元三年十一月辛丑，加諡紹統同道冠德昭功哲文神武明聖成孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In Qingyuan year three, the eleventh month, on the day xinchou, the posthumous title was augmented to Continuing the Line, Sharing the Way, Crowned in Virtue, Illustrious in Merit, Philosophical, Literary, Martial, Bright, Sagely, Achieving, and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingyuan year three, on the eleventh month's xinchou day, the posthumous title was augmented to Continuing the Line Sharing the Way Crowned in Virtue Illustrious in Merit Philosophical Literary Martial Bright Sagely Achieving Filial Emperor.
